Fellow advocates for justice and freedom, Today, we many of us stood together in the heart of our nation's capital, united by a shared purpose and an unwavering commitment to justice.

As someone from Gaza, Palestine, the struggle for Palestinian rights is deeply personal. I have witnessed the devastation, the injustice, and the unyielding resilience of my people. It is a fight that demands not only our voices but our actions.

Standing side by side with us in this fight is Dr. Jill Stein. She has been in the front row, unwavering in her support for Palestinian rights and dignity.

Her courage and determination to speak truth to power are not just commendable—they are essential. Dr. Stein embodies the spirit of resistance and the hope for a future where justice prevails.

But friends, this battle is not one we can fight alone. The least we can do to support Dr. Stein’s unwavering commitment is to bolster her campaign financially. It’s a small but significant way to contribute to the larger movement for justice. Your contributions are not just donations—they are investments in a future where voices like ours are heard, where our struggles are recognized, and where our rights are defended.

_**The time is *NOW*.** _After witnessing both Democrats and Republicans alike cheer for *Netanyahu* in our capital, it has become painfully clear that both parties have betrayed us. They have turned their backs on the principles of justice and humanity. This is the house of the people, yet it has failed to represent the true spirit and demands of the people.

[_**Let us show that we have not given up. Let us demonstrate that our fight continues, stronger than ever. | **President Joe Biden is about to address the nation for the first time since he officially dropped out of the race for President and endorsed Kamala Harris.**

So we’re sending a HUGE Thank you letter to President Biden for all of his service to our country.

[**We need 20,000 good Democrats to sign it with us — read below and sign the letter >>**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/72914?t=6&akid=15742%2E878179%2E3VkKaN) [ ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/72914?t=7&akid=15742%2E878179%2E3VkKaN) | [20,000 GOOD DEMOCRATS NEEDED: PLEASE GIVE $3 TO INSTANTLY SIGN THIS LETTER BEFORE WE CLOSE IT AT END-OF-DAY TODAY »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/72914?t=8&akid=15742%2E878179%2E3VkKaN)

Dear President Biden,

I have one thing to say to you: Thank you.

You have accomplished so much, and saved our country from the nightmare that Donald Trump left behind.

I remember how excited I was when you won in 2020.

I have had your back since you became President, and I am so proud of everything you've done for working families in our country.

You capped prices on prescription drugs.

You protected good-paying union jobs.

You passed historic legislation addressing climate change.

You have done everything in your power to strengthen our Democracy.

I have zero doubt in my mind: _You will go down as a truly GREAT American President._

**I respect your decision to step aside from the race, and I truly thank you for putting the country and our Democracy first — that is something that Trump and the Republicans will NEVER do.**

[**I'm signing this letter and sending a small donation of $3 with VPP now to show that I'm still fighting — for our country and for your legacy, Mr. President. It's more important than ever that Democrats stand united together.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/72914?t=9&akid=15742%2E878179%2E3VkKaN) | [20,000 GOOD DEMOCRATS NEEDED: PLEASE GIVE $3 TO INSTANTLY SIGN THIS LETTER BEFORE WE CLOSE IT AT END-OF-DAY TODAY »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/72914?t=10&akid=15742%2E878179%2E3VkKaN)

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1690%2E135344%2EEFiJja)

This past weekend, Joe Biden made the patriotic decision to put our democracy first and suspend his presidential campaign.
One thing is clear: Michigan is more important than ever to winning the White House this November. Our ever-so swingy swing state was the tipping point in 2016, the tipping point in 2020, and will likely be the deciding factor once again this November.
It’s no secret that this is a historic moment in our nation’s history and an inflection point in our race: Because the Senate race is the top of the ticket, our performance likely impacts the presidential and vice versa.
But I’ve won three tough elections, so I’m no stranger to responding to big moments in a campaign. In 2020, Supreme Court Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg passed away in September. In 2022, the Supreme Court struck down _Roe v. Wade_.
Both of these moments -- and the one we’re in now — had the potential to shift the future of our country. Our campaign will have to adapt, but that’s what we’re good at.
But we know that this news is also firing up the Republican base. And we need to not only match that enthusiasm but EXCEED it.
We have built a campaign that can win in November, but only with your continued support.
[**So, if holding the Senate and the White House is worth $3 to you, that is the donation we're asking you to make directly to my campaign.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240724-3-900&t=2&akid=1690%2E135344%2EEFiJja)

Friends,
America is a better place because of President Biden’s lifetime of public service.
After serving for more than three decades in the Senate and two terms as Vice President, he was elected President during a historic and difficult moment for our nation. His inauguration restored compassion, competence, and decency to the White House.
He entered the Oval Office in 2021 committed to healing our country, and he not only delivered meaningful relief to hundreds of millions of Americans after a deeply challenging time, he delivered progress that we’ll be feeling the impact of for decades to come.
More than 15 million jobs created. Historic unemployment lows and record-low child poverty. Trillions of dollars of household wealth created.
The gun show loophole closed and the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act signed into law.
A historic, bipartisan deal on infrastructure legislation that made the largest investments into our nation’s roads, bridges, and public transit systems since the Eisenhower Administration.
The CHIPS Act signed into law, strengthening our national security, improving supply chains, reducing costs, and helping us outcompete China.
Historic action to combat climate change and lower prescription drug costs.
That’s just a sliver of what the Biden-Harris Administration has done in the past three and a half years — and now, Kamala Harris is ready to unite Democrats to win in November, defeat Trump, and build on this incredible progress.
That’s why, today, I’m asking you to join me in thanking President Biden for his decades of service — and commit to supporting Kamala Harris for President. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/srIpyv3_qUiJIyAFwN3fRQ2]

President Biden deserves our respect and gratitude for all he’s done and all he will continue to do as he finishes his historic term in office. Over the past four years, the Biden Administration has made a powerful impact on our country, passing progressive legislation and supporting American families:
* Creating nearly 11 million jobs – including 750,000 manufacturing jobs – and getting unemployment down to the lowest rate in 50 years
* Making record investments in infrastructure to fix our crumbling roads and bridges
* Protecting same-sex and interracial marriage with the _Respect for Marriage Act_
* Defending access to reproductive health care
* Canceling student loans for millions of borrowers
* Passing the first meaningful federal gun safety legislation in nearly 30 years
* Taking aggressive action to combat the climate crisis, including investing in clean energy and lowering energy costs for families

**And that’s just scratching the surface.** [Will you join our team in thanking President Biden for his decades of public service and dedication to the American people? | | Dear Fellow American,Adam Schiff just held a fundraiser in California with other elitist Democrat candidates. They hob-knobbed at a brunch in LA to fund their campaigns that will further destroy California and our country as we know it._And they raised over $700,000 dollars._ But how Adam Schiff runs his campaign now says a lot about how he will operate if he beats me. body:
|
#
Folks, this is Tammy Baldwin. Growing up, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital. When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket and make enormous sacrifices to do so — _all because I had a pre-existing condition._ **That’s why I got into public service.** I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. I thought no one should ever have to go through that. But I knew they weren’t the only ones. I’m one of 133 million Americans who have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to our care — and before the _Affordable Care Act_ was passed, many of us could be denied coverage. Now, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and wrote the amendment to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. Now, when I meet with young people across Wisconsin, almost every hand in the room goes up when I ask who is on their parent’s health insurance. So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — **including my Republican opponent who called my amendment a “stupid idea” and said young people on their parent’s health insurance need to “grow up and move on.”** If Eric Hovde flips this seat and secures the Senate majority for Republicans, the _Affordable Care Act_ will be on the chopping block and countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules. That’s why I need your help to defeat him. **[So folks, will you split a donation between Tina Smith and my reelection campaign to defend our Democratic Senate majority? clean_body: | Folks, this is Tammy Baldwin. Growing up, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital. When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket and make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I had a pre-existing condition. That’s why I got into public service. I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. I thought no one should ever have to go through that. But I knew they weren’t the only ones. I’m one of 133 million Americans who have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to our care — and before the Affordable Care Act was passed, many of us could be denied coverage. Now, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and wrote the amendment to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. Now, when I meet with young people across Wisconsin, almost every hand in the room goes up when I ask who is on their parent’s health insurance. So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — including my Republican opponent who called my amendment a “stupid idea” and said young people on their parent’s health insurance need to “grow up and move on.” If Eric Hovde flips this seat and secures the Senate majority for Republicans, the Affordable Care Act will be on the chopping block and countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules. | My fellow Marylanders, Last week, the Board of Public Works voted to make sure we grow our state’s economy through critical investments while taking an important step to maintain a balanced budget through targeted cuts. From 2017 to 2022, the national economy grew by 11%. During that same time frame, Maryland’s economy grew by just 3%. Maryland was consistently falling behind other states on affordability, wages, population size and employment. Meanwhile, spending ballooned, increasing by 70% during the seven years just before I took office. In short: We were spending, but we weren’t growing. **So, we took action to turn things around.** In our plan, we prioritize investments in health care and child care – because these investments will help us make Maryland more affordable and more competitive. These changes are essential for both our short-term success and long-term growth – and they go hand-in-hand with a broader effort to get our house in order. And here’s the good news: **Our approach is already showing signs of success.** We have a long way to go to make sure our balance sheets start matching our ambition, but we’re on our way Maryland and we’re not stopping.

**

These awards will **generate new jobs** , help families **save money** , and set Maryland on track to **meet our clean energy goals**. As I always say, it isn’t enough for people to see themselves in the consequences of climate inaction, people must also see themselves in the progress – and that’s what this partnership is about.

clean_body: Our approach is already showing signs of success | | | | | | My fellow Marylanders, Last week, the Board of Public Works voted to make sure we grow our state’s economy through critical investments while taking an important step to maintain a balanced budget through targeted cuts. From 2017 to 2022, the national economy grew by 11%. During that same time frame, Maryland’s economy grew by just 3%. Maryland was consistently falling behind other states on affordability, wages, population size and employment. Meanwhile, spending ballooned, increasing by 70% during the seven years just before I took office. In short: We were spending, but we weren’t growing. So, we took action to turn things around. In our plan, we prioritize investments in health care and child care – because these investments will help us make Maryland more affordable and more competitive. These changes are essential for both our short-term success and long-term growth – and they go hand-in-hand with a broader effort to get our house in order. And here’s the good news: Our approach is already showing signs of success. We have a long way to go to make sure our balance sheets start matching our ambition, but we’re on our way Maryland and we’re not stopping. | | This week, I announced more than $130 million in Climate Pollution Reduction Grants awards from the EPA to support the creation of thousands of new clean energy jobs. The grants will also support workforce training for local workers on emerging charging technology to make Maryland more competitive in electrifying the transportation sector. In another major update: Cenergy Holdings plans to establish a cable manufacturing facility here in Maryland. Their U.S. subsidiary, Hellenic Cables Americas, officially acquired property in Wagner’s Point, where it will support hundreds of direct and indirect jobs. These awards will generate new jobs , help families save money , and set Maryland on track to meet our clean energy goals. As I always say, it isn’t enough for people to see themselves in the consequences of climate inaction, people must also see themselves in the progress – and that’s what this partnership is about. | | Remember to buy local this week – and every week – to support Maryland's small businesses! The NAACP is a living example of the light that our American experiment can bring to the world. I'm thankful to them for inviting me to speak at their 115th National Convention. | Thank you to St. Vincent de Paul Catholic Charity for all you do to serve community members. The Class of 2024, through their service, now has the privilege of shaping Maryland’s future and writing the next chapter for our state. | | | “When Marylanders buy local, they aren’t just supporting small businesses — they’re also engaging with our shared heritage and keeping our state competitive,” said Gov. | **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

Don’t worry, No Show Kehoe! Even if you’re too chicken to debate, we’ll still see you out on the campaign trail.

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Bringing community together this weekend / Estamos uniendo comunidad este fin de semana
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
THIS SATURDAY:
Fighting for the local power grid we need in Houston
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hurricane%20Beryl%20Houston%20survivors.jpeg]
The unacceptable power outage wait times in the wake of Hurricane Beryl made it crystal clear that we need a local power grid that provides affordable and reliable energy to keep the lights on and gets our communities through extreme weather events — no matter our income level, nationality, or ZIP Code.
JOIN TOP and allies on Saturday, July 27, from 12 to 3 p.m. , for a bite to eat at Tomas Bakery & Takeria in Houston, where we'll discuss how we can fight for and win a strong, resilient local grid that will better serve Houston-area residents for years to come.
RSVP HERE to attend the community event. [https://secure.everyaction.com/UJM1mRstBEOBny7yWBhsIw2]
Email Damaris Gonzalez at dgonzalez@organizetexas.org [dgonzalez@organizetexas.org] if you or others you know are in need of immediate assistance in the aftermath of Beryl, or if you’d like to volunteer to help us do wellness checks.
Joining San Antonio community members for a forum on health outcomes for people impacted by our legal system
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Bexar%20County%20Right2Justice.jpg]
BEXAR COUNTY RESIDENTS! TOP's Right2Justice campaign is proud to partner with Fighting Back, Inc. and the University of the Incarnate Word on July 27 from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. at the Barbara Jordan Community Center for a community forum and research study dedicated to assessing the health outcomes of community members impacted by our legal system. DROP BY, if you or someone you know has been directly impacted.
Breakfast and lunch will be provided!
REGISTER to attend and for a chance to win a $25 VISA gift card. [https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=CdMlBrzFIEGYKOo9cHGvGbHC6uKGnr9OkYAzEaKyh-xURFA3N05YQzQ5TFlEMVFEOVFPTFBGSUpCNy4u]
For more information about TOP’s Right2Justice work in Bexar County, contact Laquita Garcia at lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
A political passing of the torch and an opportunity
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Kamala%20and%20Biden.jpeg]
We commend President Biden’s decision to transition leadership and pass the torch to a new generation.
His presidential term has been one of the most consequential in recent history for our nation, and has brought with it progressive milestones — including passage of the Inflation Reduction Act, the strengthening of workers’ rights, and the appointment of the country’s first Black woman Supreme Court justice.
Vice President Harris now has the chance to build on these achievements, and go further with policies that will uplift all who proudly call this home – regardless of our age, race, or gender.
As we get closer to the fall election, TOP is committed as ever in defeating the threats posed by Donald Trump, his MAGA agenda, and Project 2025. Our fight for racial and economic justice continues.
TOP Tips: Fight the power -- read banned books this summer!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Fist%20air%20banned%20books.jpeg]
Try as they might, far-right extremists will never erase our identities, our dreams, or the invaluable impact our communities' stories have had (and continue to have) on society. We're not allowing censorship in the name of white supremacy to stop our stories from being told and celebrated. Browse through this list of credible websites where you can read recently banned books for free. [https://mashable.com/article/read-banned-books-access]
Español
ESTE SÁBADO:
Luchando por la red eléctrica local que necesitamos en Houston
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hurricane%20Beryl%20Houston%20survivors.jpeg]
Los inaceptables tiempos de espera para restaurar la energía eléctrica después del huracán Beryl dejaron en claro que necesitamos una red eléctrica local que proporcione energía asequible y confiable para mantener las luces encendidas y ayudar a nuestras comunidades a superar eventos climáticos extremos, sin importar nuestro nivel de ingresos. nacionalidad o código postal.
ÚNASE a TOP y sus aliados el sábado 27 de julio, de 12 a 3 p.m ., para comer algo en Tomas Bakery & Takeria en Houston, donde discutiremos cómo podemos luchar y ganar una red local fuerte y resiliente que mejorará servir a los residentes del área de Houston en los años venideros.
Confirme su asistencia AQUÍ para asistir al evento comunitario. [https://secure.everyaction.com/UJM1mRstBEOBny7yWBhsIw2]
Envíe un correo electrónico a Damaris González a dgonzalez@organizetexas.org [dgonzalez@organizetexas.org] si usted u otras personas que conoce necesitan asistencia inmediata después de Beryl, o si desea ofrecerse como voluntario para ayudarnos a realizar controles de bienestar.
Unirse a miembros de la comunidad de San Antonio para un foro sobre resultados de salud para las personas afectadas por nuestro sistema legal
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Bexar%20County%20Right2Justice.jpg]
¡RESIDENTES DEL CONDADO DE BEXAR! La campaña Right2Justice de TOP se enorgullece de asociarse con Fighting Back, Inc. y la Universidad del Verbo Encarnado el 27 de julio de 10 a.m. a 2 p.m. en el Centro Comunitario Barbara Jordan para un foro comunitario y un estudio de investigación dedicado a evaluar los resultados de salud de los miembros de la comunidad afectados por nuestro sistema legal. Únete a nosotros, si tú o alguien que conoces se ha visto directamente afectado.
¡Se proveerá desayuno y almuerzo!
REGÍSTRESE para asistir y tener la oportunidad de ganar una tarjeta de regalo VISA de $25. [https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=CdMlBrzFIEGYKOo9cHGvGbHC6uKGnr9OkYAzEaKyh-xURFA3N05YQzQ5TFlEMVFEOVFPTFBGSUpCNy4u]
Para obtener más información sobre el trabajo Right2Justice de TOP en el condado de Bexar, comuníquese con Laquita García en lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
Un paso de la antorcha política y una oportunidad
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Kamala%20and%20Biden.jpeg]
Elogiamos la decisión del presidente Biden de realizar una transición de liderazgo y pasar la antorcha a una nueva generación.
Su mandato presidencial ha sido uno de los más trascendentales en la historia reciente de nuestra nación y ha traído consigo hitos progresistas, incluida la aprobación de la Ley de Reducción de la Inflación, el fortalecimiento de los derechos de los trabajadores, y el nombramiento de la primera mujer negra para la Corte Suprema.
La vicepresidenta Harris ahora tiene la oportunidad de aprovechar estos logros e ir más allá con políticas que enaltezcan a todos los que orgullosamente llaman a esto su hogar, independientemente de nuestra edad, raza o género.
A medida que nos acercamos a las elecciones de otoño, TOP está más comprometido que nunca en derrotar las amenazas planteadas por Donald Trump, su agenda MAGA y el Proyecto 2025. Nuestra lucha por la justicia racial y económica continúa.
Consejos de TOP: Luche contra el poder -- Lea libros prohibidos este verano
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Fist%20air%20banned%20books.jpeg]
Por mucho que lo intenten, los extremistas de extrema derecha nunca borrarán nuestras identidades, nuestros sueños o el impacto invaluable que las historias de nuestras comunidades han tenido (y continúan teniendo) en la sociedad. No permitiremos que la censura en nombre de la supremacía blanca impida que se cuenten y celebren nuestras historias. Explore esta lista de sitios web confiables donde puede leer libros prohibidos recientemente de forma gratuita. [https://mashable.com/article/read-banned-books-access?emci=0564c479-1727-ee11-a9bb-00224832e1ba&emdi=fcaa1fc9-3c2c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ceid=13522]

700 S. Zarzamora, Suite 212
San Antonio, TX 78207
United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please unsubscribe: https://secure.everyaction.com/p/_pdeZq7FqkSM3uHo3kegbw2?unsubscribedata=qugWEbQTEKV4gUWvX%2BCnBzdf9NnEMkJYeyd6rY%2FkvVfx8CVKiBVje6zR6u%2FbOM0ksuqGJQv0nlJCPK8VgOAWHiQeC3OepCswfyMtzj09We207SJZ7vkunZougmu4%2B5Wy50jbaUmAbj0cD%2BZFqm1bJljleShTtG0Nbes10xQWwnEvtR%2FeAwfZSJGHDpnjdoFwrk0NOtxsmgBuTuCZ6Z0Tt5p5WXB2wSNE6WRyjHEsf5TBKT3SC5thvxQ0bWVt7NSwq9TwdsNChT5hwnkDzEDCJAHEQJiWFOrZytETaAcRmUq1L6L9ZlTTW%2BXXuX1WzsQoRVPfiAEan4xS7qf5PoA95uRlN3%2BVK6l3IB1kRrCpx%2FT3KXHlhtHzySynU%2FpVFcu4API2hfk2ijS2A9snuiF4eeo6Rol6m7JtUGwy6qQwemY%3D .

| | Friend,

I'm excited to offer you a complimentary copy of the ebook "Created Equal", written by famed economist Milton Friedman. In this insightful work, Friedman meticulously examines the intricate interplay between equality and liberty--two cornerstone concepts in the American ethos.

From the era preceding the Declaration of Independence to contemporary debates, "Created Equal" traces the evolution of these ideals and their impact on our social, political, and economic landscape. In twenty-five pages of thought-provoking analysis and historical context, Friedman describes pivotal moments such as the Civil War and shifts in societal perspectives on equality.

This ebook doesn't just offer historical retrospection but also serves as a compass guiding us toward the future. By unraveling the complexities of equality, liberty, and their inherent conflicts, it sparks critical reflections on the essence of democracy and individual rights. name: Jenna Burns
subject: Targeting my husband and President Trump
body:
Before I ask for your help, let me start at the beginning...

Dear Friend,

If the name Fani Willis sounds familiar to you, there's a reason.

She's the radical District Attorney in Georgia who's been trying to put President Trump behind bars.

But President Trump isn't the only person Fani Willis is abusing her office to target.

She's also trying to lock my husband away for the _rest_ _of_ _his_ _life_ for doing his job as a police officer and trying to keep our city safe.

**[Before I ask for your help, let me start at the beginning...](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z6otns9cq7lefiblgs35g3d8oi4kv3q8s0ovqms0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cjg68or5c3h2bs)**

My husband, James, served in the Atlanta Police Department. That's me, James, and our son in the photo I sent.
[](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z97o75tcs6pabt6hcflgnj1ddsmgeabul5lrioc0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cjg68or5c3h2bs)
Being a police officer meant the world to James. He was born and raised in Atlanta, and saw his job as a way to help his neighbors. But if Fani Willis has her way... **_life in prison_** could be his reward.

Our nightmare started more than eight years ago, when an off-duty police officer radioed in about a man breaking into a parked car at an apartment complex.

Then the officer stopped responding. Dispatch issued a distress call, and all available units rushed over.

My husband was closest to the scene, so he arrived first. When he got there, he saw a running car parked facing the wrong way on a one-way street. With his emergency lights on, James got out to investigate.

That's when it happened.

The suspect saw my husband, slammed on the gas, and drove straight at him.

James was certain the man was intentionally trying to run him over.

With only a split second to think, James drew his weapon and fired a single shot at the vehicle bearing down on him. It struck the suspect, who died instantly.

James was shaken by the incident, but thankfully he was unhurt. He went home, certain he had done everything by the book. **So you can imagine our shock when James found out he was being charged with murder!**

James was forced to turn himself in, and spent the night locked up in jail in solitary confinement. They treated him like a common criminal. They even kept him in a straitjacket!

We all thought this was a giant misunderstanding -- just a soft-on-crime District Attorney trying to make a name for themselves by targeting a police officer.

We couldn't have been more wrong.

You see, James is white, and the suspect he shot was black. So the woke, anti-police prosecutors in Atlanta have made it their mission to destroy my husband.

For eight years now, these radical prosecutors -- and the woke mob who helped get them elected -- have dragged my husband's name through the mud.

The District Attorney at the time held press conferences bragging about how tough they were for going after my husband. They even campaigned on putting my James behind bars!

Every time James has to appear at the Fulton County Courthouse for a hearing, angry protesters show up carrying giant signs with James' mugshot on them, with “MURDERER” scribbled across his face in red spray paint.

Now you understand why I'm so upset and why **[I'm turning to you for help.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zal7sjd6g2d7unk3begafiec8qbpjktr915nlgvg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cjg68or5c3h2bs)**

James is an honest, hardworking, good-hearted man who only wants to help people.

He's the guy everyone calls when a broken faucet floods their kitchen, or when their car breaks down.

When he was younger, he spent years traveling to dangerous Third-World countries to help needy people -- places like South Sudan, Madagascar, Liberia, and Haiti. And it was that same selflessness that drove James to become a police officer and graduate the police academy near the top of his class.

My husband is _exactly_ the kind of man you want keeping your city safe.

But none of that matters to radical prosecutors like Fani Willis. She _knows_ what happened that night. She _knows_ James was in a life-or-death situation. She _knows_ that the charge should have been dropped years ago.

But Fani Willis doesn't care.

She just wants to make an example out of my husband. For years, we've been trapped in limbo.

James' police department just threw us away. There's supposed to be this bond of brotherhood in law enforcement. But his fellow officers were forbidden to talk to him -- and the higher-ups fired him before the investigation was even finished.

We've lost nearly all our friends, and we've even been forced to move because of the terrible lies the prosecutors have been spreading about my husband.

It's been nearly impossible for James to get a job with these charges hanging over him.

By some miracle, we've been able to get by, but every day is difficult. And what's been truly overwhelming is the cost of James' legal defense.

My friend, we aren't wealthy people. James' father had to empty his retirement account. Other relatives have sold family heirlooms. We've put nearly every penny we can scrape together into this case.

And it still hasn't been enough.

I know this is how Fani Willis and the radical prosecutors in her office are trying to punish my husband. They're dragging this out as long as possible to break our family.

Earlier this year, we ran out of money. James was about to turn to a public defender. We had all but given up hope... **And then we got a call from Jason Johnson, the President of the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund, or LELDF.**

If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongfully-accused police officers like James.

LELDF has helped dozens of innocent officers -- and their families – at their lowest moment.

And we _were_ at our lowest moment!

Not only did the LELDF board decide to help my husband get the legal defense he deserves, they're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys so James can finally clear his name.

That's why I'm writing to you today to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone...

**[Could you send a contribution today to help defend James?](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zcsp2rcktu4jei5pkp5d5kppc32ssgd0k0daf748_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cjg68or5c3h2bs)**

James' trial is scheduled for November. His legal team needs to be working day and night to get ready to defeat Fani Willis's team and get my husband declared NOT GUILTY once and for all.

I know that times are tough right now. And if we had any other options, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for help from a stranger.

But like I mentioned earlier, we have nowhere else to turn. And I'm so scared for what will happen to my husband.

You know how police officers are treated behind bars. If James is convicted, it's basically a death sentence.

**[So, if you're at all able, would you consider making a tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or $1,000 to LELDF to help wrongfully-accused officers like James?](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2ze6hqfeam5lgnhpidnh65ehndflb4i61ec3022ng_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cjg68or5c3h2bs)**

LELDF is a non-profit organization. So your gift is tax-deductible.

And it's your **[$35 gift](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zs0rlp6tpajd753h6esfaoc1gno0g9ila33bgbsg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cjg68or5c3h2bs)** that could make the difference between defeating Fani Willis and the radical anti-police prosecutors on her team -- and my husband spending the _rest_ _of_ _his_ _life_ in prison.

I'm sorry this e-mail turned out so long. Thank you for taking the time to read about my husband. And thank you in advance for helping my James.

Sincerely,
Jenna Burns

P.S. My husband did EVERYTHING he needed to survive that night. He doesn't deserve to die in prison. But that's EXACTLY what will happen if radical prosecutor Fani Willis gets her way. Please help James before it's too late! **[Follow this link right now to make your best tax-deductible gift of $35 or more to LELDF.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zm3nojadrhdh8tfctste8ga5vr94gvcv7ruk5hug_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cjg68or5c3h2bs)** Thank you for helping me save my husband and my family.
--------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit**www.PoliceDefense.org**. And remember -Blue Lives Matter!_

body:
Before I ask for your help, let me start at the beginning...

Dear Friend,

If the name Fani Willis sounds familiar to you, there's a reason.

She's the radical District Attorney in Georgia who's been trying to put President Trump behind bars.

But President Trump isn't the only person Fani Willis is abusing her office to target.

She's also trying to lock my husband away for the _rest_ _of_ _his_ _life_ for doing his job as a police officer and trying to keep our city safe.

**[Before I ask for your help, let me start at the beginning...](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=27fa97ba7acc4bce8368353564ed9b14&_e=XMqV5Tb1zXxLCVQYhTOxQzSNvBnpVD09zXzZj6QaqJ-lb9Cof9Wd6nakGTpVcB3jntztniAy4gsCi-cxSaP3JW4JF4V8q5_ykLELkoZpnpWD0PLnIMkmk-vl8ybrORsOyyNPnf1rcu0i9l66XRsfzaGhyghV-zLuW7M21KAVNU3xuF-U5mdsecqRz8SCcbUAmXdwQEaiao4oDJsk-rPeTBxP2XUmrp3g6n6vSnvza1L_9peV0Bxs3uVvuA0YVQFloLw08Ae70g8YixmWBVx19Pm5XdWkGhZa2wUYfzhWaxzR17Q8RdDW-3izDmqa4qTwMjLzrpA63qetUlNSP2drnBKAqpxcb3pZK70aa2zCrVFo41nXSVR2q4viLmbp6u5hihyilhGl5tm49YGC86cc_g%3D%3D)**

My husband, James, served in the Atlanta Police Department. That's me, James, and our son in the photo I sent.
[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=27fa97ba7acc4bce8368353564ed9b14&_e=XMqV5Tb1zXxLCVQYhTOxQzSNvBnpVD09zXzZj6QaqJ-lb9Cof9Wd6nakGTpVcB3jntztniAy4gsCi-cxSaP3JW4JF4V8q5_ykLELkoZpnpWD0PLnIMkmk-vl8ybrORsOyyNPnf1rcu0i9l66XRsfzaGhyghV-zLuW7M21KAVNU3xuF-U5mdsecqRz8SCcbUAmXdwQEaiao4oDJsk-rPeTBxP2XUmrp3g6n6vSnvza1IYN6jORqyUZ5Ln0StPUUXJkBSHp1HUMM7qnjrgGbn_fw3ZIuJeH-x8Nk68wbTHMOm_EeMNYNYlsT_ExkVdMCLQ0aOfTorElwkj8afR2a6UeQwnEuhLmcBKyaoefdW9itLHgrAhkTuPyabBp7Bnsr0LsWm0cMsK4Hc0yz3iwCpGfg%3D%3D)
Being a police officer meant the world to James. He was born and raised in Atlanta, and saw his job as a way to help his neighbors. But if Fani Willis has her way... **_life in prison_** could be his reward.

Our nightmare started more than eight years ago, when an off-duty police officer radioed in about a man breaking into a parked car at an apartment complex.

Then the officer stopped responding. Dispatch issued a distress call, and all available units rushed over.

My husband was closest to the scene, so he arrived first. When he got there, he saw a running car parked facing the wrong way on a one-way street. With his emergency lights on, James got out to investigate.

That's when it happened.

The suspect saw my husband, slammed on the gas, and drove straight at him.

James was certain the man was intentionally trying to run him over.

With only a split second to think, James drew his weapon and fired a single shot at the vehicle bearing down on him. It struck the suspect, who died instantly.

James was shaken by the incident, but thankfully he was unhurt. He went home, certain he had done everything by the book. **So you can imagine our shock when James found out he was being charged with murder!**

James was forced to turn himself in, and spent the night locked up in jail in solitary confinement. They treated him like a common criminal. They even kept him in a straitjacket!

We all thought this was a giant misunderstanding -- just a soft-on-crime District Attorney trying to make a name for themselves by targeting a police officer.

We couldn't have been more wrong.

You see, James is white, and the suspect he shot was black. So the woke, anti-police prosecutors in Atlanta have made it their mission to destroy my husband.

For eight years now, these radical prosecutors -- and the woke mob who helped get them elected -- have dragged my husband's name through the mud.

The District Attorney at the time held press conferences bragging about how tough they were for going after my husband. They even campaigned on putting my James behind bars!

Every time James has to appear at the Fulton County Courthouse for a hearing, angry protesters show up carrying giant signs with James' mugshot on them, with "MURDERER" scribbled across his face in red spray paint.

Now you understand why I'm so upset and why **[I'm turning to you for help.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=27fa97ba7acc4bce8368353564ed9b14&_e=XMqV5Tb1zXxLCVQYhTOxQzSNvBnpVD09zXzZj6QaqJ-lb9Cof9Wd6nakGTpVcB3jntztniAy4gsCi-cxSaP3JW4JF4V8q5_ykLELkoZpnpWD0PLnIMkmk-vl8ybrORsOyyNPnf1rcu0i9l66XRsfzaGhyghV-zLuW7M21KAVNU3xuF-U5mdsecqRz8SCcbUAmXdwQEaiao4oDJsk-rPeTBxP2XUmrp3g6n6vSnvza1Jf4JK1PFEfF88jzLQ-lSq6Ra1obqivQLJvV-2QuceS16wxAtdAam0wWUQFH1zDs-65_vjlqp-8tf3MiQCYv26x9bcOBynQZ9FFUFCr1Nj8n132Vz7FIR6i0DsLVA2tBsZ4Lv2Zw4GaHZUfGUKiGZqvgqvJqKe2kBZhTeCuIg2emg%3D%3D)**

James is an honest, hardworking, good-hearted man who only wants to help people.

He's the guy everyone calls when a broken faucet floods their kitchen, or when their car breaks down.

When he was younger, he spent years traveling to dangerous Third-World countries to help needy people -- places like South Sudan, Madagascar, Liberia, and Haiti. And it was that same selflessness that drove James to become a police officer and graduate the police academy near the top of his class.

My husband is _exactly_ the kind of man you want keeping your city safe.

But none of that matters to radical prosecutors like Fani Willis. She _knows_ what happened that night. She _knows_ James was in a life-or-death situation. She _knows_ that the charge should have been dropped years ago.

But Fani Willis doesn't care.

She just wants to make an example out of my husband. For years, we've been trapped in limbo.

James' police department just threw us away. There's supposed to be this bond of brotherhood in law enforcement. But his fellow officers were forbidden to talk to him -- and the higher-ups fired him before the investigation was even finished.

We've lost nearly all our friends, and we've even been forced to move because of the terrible lies the prosecutors have been spreading about my husband.

It's been nearly impossible for James to get a job with these charges hanging over him.

By some miracle, we've been able to get by, but every day is difficult. And what's been truly overwhelming is the cost of James' legal defense.

My friend, we aren't wealthy people. James' father had to empty his retirement account. Other relatives have sold family heirlooms. We've put nearly every penny we can scrape together into this case.

And it still hasn't been enough.

I know this is how Fani Willis and the radical prosecutors in her office are trying to punish my husband. They're dragging this out as long as possible to break our family.

Earlier this year, we ran out of money. James was about to turn to a public defender. We had all but given up hope... **And then we got a call from Jason Johnson, the President of the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund, or LELDF.**

If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongfully-accused police officers like James.

LELDF has helped dozens of innocent officers -- and their families - at their lowest moment.

And we _were_ at our lowest moment!

Not only did the LELDF board decide to help my husband get the legal defense he deserves, they're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys so James can finally clear his name.

That's why I'm writing to you today to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone...

**[Could you send a contribution today to help defend James?](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=27fa97ba7acc4bce8368353564ed9b14&_e=XMqV5Tb1zXxLCVQYhTOxQzSNvBnpVD09zXzZj6QaqJ-lb9Cof9Wd6nakGTpVcB3jntztniAy4gsCi-cxSaP3JW4JF4V8q5_ykLELkoZpnpWD0PLnIMkmk-vl8ybrORsOyyNPnf1rcu0i9l66XRsfzaGhyghV-zLuW7M21KAVNU3xuF-U5mdsecqRz8SCcbUAmXdwQEaiao4oDJsk-rPeTBxP2XUmrp3g6n6vSnvza1KDZ7-QPGiqpQ9h36hS870xQ9lqi3T39Av77x9y3FZXFs8Ms_7-J9_ZT8VhI9IDPAAqDjPnriCF8Fr6AhE3U1zugPxz0VrvEX_aE0ODtkjvLDdbROY1RopXBIV9ZwwSyXIj85V_8-gi8GO-86OPrDdGUOiRqtSjxI5RR9XPABvLMQ%3D%3D)**

James' trial is scheduled for November. His legal team needs to be working day and night to get ready to defeat Fani Willis's team and get my husband declared NOT GUILTY once and for all.

I know that times are tough right now. And if we had any other options, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for help from a stranger.

But like I mentioned earlier, we have nowhere else to turn. And I'm so scared for what will happen to my husband.

You know how police officers are treated behind bars. If James is convicted, it's basically a death sentence.

**[So, if you're at all able, would you consider making a tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or $1,000 to LELDF to help wrongfully-accused officers like James?](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=27fa97ba7acc4bce8368353564ed9b14&_e=XMqV5Tb1zXxLCVQYhTOxQzSNvBnpVD09zXzZj6QaqJ-lb9Cof9Wd6nakGTpVcB3jntztniAy4gsCi-cxSaP3JW4JF4V8q5_ykLELkoZpnpWD0PLnIMkmk-vl8ybrORsOyyNPnf1rcu0i9l66XRsfzaGhyghV-zLuW7M21KAVNU3xuF-U5mdsecqRz8SCcbUAmXdwQEaiao4oDJsk-rPeTBxP2XUmrp3g6n6vSnvza1LF_04sMGPNjHqwB37ssFbTZyQ5QrKGad9oUDcqO5JwW-3pBh1RHUmQSj-WcIbONNUoI3XoPVzLrDFkWEsT6FZuooiGD22MoFw23QSCGblpdE3EByh1FVPJMchLQ0IfDrWxFI2Li7KSXt1oDdwKaZN66nHJ8omJQJJTo77mtWYd3g%3D%3D)**

LELDF is a non-profit organization. So your gift is tax-deductible.

And it's your **[$35 gift](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=27fa97ba7acc4bce8368353564ed9b14&_e=XMqV5Tb1zXxLCVQYhTOxQzSNvBnpVD09zXzZj6QaqJ-lb9Cof9Wd6nakGTpVcB3jntztniAy4gsCi-cxSaP3JW4JF4V8q5_ykLELkoZpnpWD0PLnIMkmk-vl8ybrORsOyyNPnf1rcu0i9l66XRsfzaGhyghV-zLuW7M21KAVNU3xuF-U5mdsecqRz8SCcbUAmXdwQEaiao4oDJsk-rPeTBxP2XUmrp3g6n6vSnvza1JmnxHDZNFow0nA7R5vIw1Ld7m4U6UzKAJVzeojM1cbKv-SiapBOuOuvCQ3GKk5_QNfZfsjzOewGkmDLFtlGSH8n691aNojetpTlOLRpRSGizH0gA39ROXAT4v2k1wmguh9OyVlNFbP4q4A1SNHz70GnAFJ5g8uu45y5_bL9vF4Vg%3D%3D)** that could make the difference between defeating Fani Willis and the radical anti-police prosecutors on her team -- and my husband spending the _rest_ _of_ _his_ _life_ in prison.

I'm sorry this e-mail turned out so long. Thank you for taking the time to read about my husband. And thank you in advance for helping my James.

Sincerely,
Jenna Burns

My husband did EVERYTHING he needed to survive that night. He doesn't deserve to die in prison. But that's EXACTLY what will happen if radical prosecutor Fani Willis gets her way. | | | | **_🚨 BREAKING NEWS 🚨_** folks, The presidential race has changed dramatically, with initial polls showing Vice President Kamala Harris leading former President Donald Trump by a close margin. A national presidential poll released Tuesday by Reuters/Ipsos found that Harris is narrowly leading Trump. The poll shows Harris with 44% support compared to Trump's 42%, a difference within the 3-percentage-point margin of error. This is a notable shift from last week's poll, where President Joe Biden faced a two-point deficit against Trump before he announced his exit from the race and endorsed Harris. The new poll, conducted on Monday and Tuesday, followed both the Republican National Convention, where Trump formally accepted the nomination, and Biden’s announcement that he was leaving the race and supporting Harris. Harris's campaign has stated that she has secured the Democratic nomination, positioning her as the front-runner with endorsements from a majority of elected Democrats. While national surveys provide key insights, the ultimate decision lies with a handful of competitive states in the U.S. Electoral College. Polls indicate that Harris will face significant challenges in these key battleground states, where Trump has shown strong support. However, this election presents a unique opportunity to make a difference, especially in rural America. Many Americans, including those in rural communities, are opposed to the MAGA agenda. ---|---

## Biden Speaks to the Nation
President Biden last night [addressed the nation](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O8yAQAJ8Gd0SwBjspKL7GXb72SmttlrA5fiLMJbq3P-Xqq0eakebjul6RE5fbf8zkeqgr7p2ftM4SrASzmsG7QAQ0DuT0DPqirdJmiC6onQj8iIFGbccwkT7jjJveACaAbWAHCoyawWqlNNgTWbA2BG-C1vZMQRhFnnttp3vl0iOF9F2f1E57zUNysffHIcZ_AhYBS48UOaU3E7DEmqnQ6xCwoM9c-OgNO9ciYDHzRU96lvdKcmNPRXrKdW_YD_lVuJP8xIwJZcTW-K0YmvOPF6fExzQLo24Z-bc09L-fPB38BAAA__-brmUA) for the first time since withdrawing from the 2024 election, saying he left the race because "the defense of democracy" was more important than his personal ambition. In a speech that hit many of the Democratic Party's main talking points, he outlined his plans as president for the next six months, including reforming the Supreme Court, working for gun control, and fighting "extremism and hate." Biden spoke glowingly of his own record, particularly on the economy, crime, and border control, but said it was time to hand the reins over to younger leaders. _" The best way forward is to pass the torch to a new generation,"_ he said. He ended with [an endorsement of VP Kamala Harris](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuhDAQBb_G7ozsxT7uChdp6C5tSmTw7rEngxF2QPn7iNTpnvRGGs3Xc3gGTry-PsOCvlIewlT5wKFT4BTYwcroCRGwlehNB-ZhnDZWzv4eLLZkR-MQH5YIonMmPu4TtnAzHUr2oMHqDpzR2oBr0IFzRNGSMe6OJKzGyDXvzTvzWmek9JMP3JspLzL5udatiPZDQC-gP8-zmcay4lmuX0B_TQH9O6MaOeKq4p63ovJ3VfkISWUinlCFGHcsFyl3H7eTU-Jy64TVryVw-pPV_9MPD78BAAD___2zXHA), the Democrats likely presidential nominee, and concluded, _" It has been the privilege of my life to serve this nation for over 50 years."_

Dear Peter,
In 2008, at the time of the Iraq war, my oldest son, Steve, was attending college on a full scholarship when he called my wife and me to tell us he was joining the Army. You may recall that in 2008, the war was not going well. Every day, there were news reports of Soldiers being killed by roadside bombs. I told him, "Don't sign anything!" I immediately drove five hours to meet him. I asked him, "Steven, why are you doing this? You don't need the money." He replied, "I'm not doing it for the money." I then suggested that we talk to the Air Force. He said that he had already considered that, but he was joining the Army because they would guarantee he could learn a foreign language. I asked him, "What language do you want to learn?" He replied, "Arabic." I told him that if he learned Arabic, they would send him to Iraq. His response was three words: "I know, Dad." Steven joined the Army because he thought it was his duty to serve. Sure enough, after completing his basic and military intelligence training and 18 months of language school, he received orders for Iraq. At that time, I had been out of the military for more than 12 years. I immediately rejoined so that I could serve with my son. In 2010-2011, Steve and I deployed to Iraq. It was an honor to serve on the battlefield with my son; it was terrifying for my wife.

---
| |
---|---
This story helps explain why I am running for Congress. I love this country, but I'm concerned with its direction. I want my children and grandchildren to grow up with the same freedoms and opportunities I've had. Therefore, three years ago, I sold my business and quit my job to spend full time talking to the people of Nevada's First Congressional District.
Although the last election was the first time I had ever run for public office, I came very close to beating Dina Titus, a liberal career politician with no real-world experience.
I beat Titus in Henderson, Boulder City, and by 20 points with in-person voters. She won with mail-in voters and through ballot harvesting. She received just 51.6 percent of the vote, the smallest percentage of all other Democrats who won Congressional races in Nevada.
Like Abraham Lincoln and Ronald Reagan, who lost their first elections, I've learned some valuable lessons that we will use to beat Titus this year.
Why this time will be different than last time
Last time Titus won by 7,000 votes
This time Dem registrations are down by 2,000, and Republicans are up by 5,000
Last time Dems were 36% of Registered Voters
This time Dems are only 32% of Registered Voters
Last time I beat Titus by 20-points with in-person voters,
Last Time Titus won with mail-in and ballot harvesting
Last time 46,000 registered Reps didn't vote
This time Republicans are encouraging early and mail-in voting
Last time was the first time I ever ran for public office
This time I have name recognition
Last time we tried to ignore the abortion issue
This time we're tackling the issue head-on
Last time Republican enthusiasm was muted
This time Democrat enthusiasm is almost non-existent
This time I've grown my grassroots operation significantly
This time we are combining efforts with down-ballot candidates
This time we are concentrating our efforts on independent voters, the largest segment of registered voters

> Dear Peter, this is Rep. Greg Landsman - Democrat, and J.D. Vance’s representative in Congress. As kids, JD Vance and I grew up near each other in Butler County, Ohio. Now, he’s my constituent in OH-01. And while our paths have crossed in many ways, our visions for our country could not be more different. The recent assassination attempt of former President Trump has made one thing clear: we must come together to oppose the divisive and dangerous agenda he represents. But let me be clear: JD Vance is not a unity selection. Mr. Vance’s track record speaks for itself: [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T32095f8c-65e3-47dd-9a11-426f0638bcd3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) It’s the role Vance is playing in fanning the flames of political division that makes him uniquely unfit for this moment of national unity and shared purpose. So, I’m asking for your help. We are locked in a tough re-election battle in a toss-up district Democrats need to hold to keep House control. If Trump & Vance win, that could be our last blue bulwark against a red trifecta in Washington. Your contribution today will help us fight back against the extremism that JD Vance represents. And it’ll show Mr. Vance that he does not represent our values – here in Ohio and across the country. [Peter, can we count on your support today? Please split a donation right now between Blue Amp Action and our re-election campaign to get the word out in Ohio and keep the House blue.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T600d7452-68a0-4396-b9ef-7f46357af7ec/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Every donation, no matter the size, makes a difference in this critical fight for our future.

| | | About BlueAmp Action: We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! # [Before instant photos, Polaroid created goggles for dogs.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh6elm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Science & Industry](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh6elm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh6elm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| I nventor Edwin Land is often referred to as the “original Steve Jobs.” The founder of Polaroid made a lasting impact on the photography world with the introduction of instant photos in 1948. But even before that, Polaroid experimented with other innovative products, all based on Land’s plastic-sheet light polarizers, patented in 1933. Researchers from General Motors, General Electric, and Kodak were intrigued by the possibilities of polarizer sheets, and Land pioneered a groundbreaking 3D movie process. Kodak became his first customer in 1934, buying the product to use in camera filters, and the following year, American Optical began buying polarizer-laminated sunglass filters, which Land had long thought would be helpful to reduce headlight glare while driving.
---
Despite Land’s momentum, Polaroid, like many other American companies in 1940, altered its strategy and production to assist World War II efforts. The U.S. government’s Office of Scientific Research and Development recruited Land and his company, and working with the National Defense Research Committee, they created a slew of Polaroid products using polarizer technology for military use: aerial survey equipment, tank telescopes, gunsights, flight training machines, and infrared night viewing devices, to name a few. Among the most commonly used objects that came out of this wartime production were goggles; _Life_ magazine even noted in a [February 1944 issue](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh6elm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) that “every U.S. fire-control instrument is equipped with filters and every second man in combat wears filter goggles. Most of these are produced by the Polaroid Corp.” The goggles weren’t just for humans, either: Polaroid produced special goggles to [keep debris out of the eyes](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh6elm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) of dogs and mules, wartime companions who fulfilled countless important roles on the battlefield, including guarding, rescuing, and transporting materials and even soldiers.

## Polaroid warned people not to shake their pictures after the Outkast song “Hey Ya!” came out.
When Atlanta hip-hop group Outkast released their song “Hey Ya!” in August 2003, one lyric in particular stuck in listeners' ears and imaginations: “Shake it like a Polaroid picture.” Rapper André 3000 was talking about dancing, and he was referencing the long-held belief that you were supposed to shake a Polaroid photo to help it develop. The instant photos did, at one time, have a finish that needed time to dry, but the modern version develops behind a plastic coating. After the song’s popularity soared, Polaroid even offered guidance to users on its website: “Rapid movement during development can cause portions of the film to separate prematurely, or can cause 'blobs' in the picture,” the company [warned](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh6elm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com). André 3000, when later asked about the iconic lyric, admits it wasn’t that deep. “In rap, lyric writing is what comes to mind, that was just the visual I had,” he [said](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh6elm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com). “And you're apparently not even supposed to do that.”

Most of these are produced by the Polaroid Corp.” The goggles weren’t just for humans, either: Polaroid produced special goggles to of dogs and mules, wartime companions who fulfilled countless important roles on the battlefield, including guarding, rescuing, and transporting materials and even soldiers. | Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | By the Numbers | | Total number of patents Edwin Land was granted 535 | | Estimated year that the Indigenous Inupiaq people made dog goggles from whale baleen 1890 | Estimated year that the Indigenous Inupiaq people made dog goggles from whale baleen 1890 | | Percentage of World War II-era Disney productions that were made for military use 90% | | Year Lady Gaga became Polaroid’s creative director 2010 | Year Lady Gaga became Polaroid’s creative director 2010 | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- Polaroid warned people not to shake their pictures after the Outkast song “Hey Ya!” came out. When Atlanta hip-hop group Outkast released their song “Hey Ya!” in August 2003, one lyric in particular stuck in listeners' ears and imaginations: “Shake it like a Polaroid picture.” Rapper André 3000 was talking about dancing, and he was referencing the long-held belief that you were supposed to shake a Polaroid photo to help it develop. The instant photos did, at one time, have a finish that needed time to dry, but the modern version develops behind a plastic coating. After the song’s popularity soared, Polaroid even offered guidance to users on its website: “Rapid movement during development can cause portions of the film to separate prematurely, or can cause 'blobs' in the picture,” the company . André 3000, when later asked about the iconic lyric, admits it wasn’t that deep. “In rap, lyric writing is what comes to mind, that was just the visual I had,” he . “And you're apparently not even supposed to do that.” Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | Recommended Reading | | | ---|---|--- | | | ---|---|--- | | | ---|--- | ---|--- A daily digest of history's most fascinating happenings. | Want to unsubscribe? | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|--- Copyright © 2024 History Facts. body:
I don't often get to say this…

Friends,

I don't often get to say this,
but I have GOOD news to report from the King County Courthouse.
That's right, despite the slew of bad legislation that so often
comes out of the King County Council undermining public safety, I
am thrilled to get to report to you on a fantastic development.

Yesterday, my legislation to keep
the Juvenile Detention Center open-a direct afront to activist
attempts to close the jail and end secure detention in King
County for even the most dangerous offenders-was passed
unanimously by the Law and Justice Committee!

However, we are not past the
finish line yet. As you may know, radical Seattle politicians and
activists have been attempting to close King County's only youth
detention center and place violent criminals in unsecured respite
homes in neighborhoods across our community. Their extreme and
dangerous plan would put murderers, rapists, and violent
offenders back on the streets with no coherent plan to keep
victims safe or stop criminals from re-offending.

Will you stand with me to send a
message to the King County Council that our community does not
support violent criminals being let off the hook?

Sadly, this misguided attempt to
help violent offenders avoid consequences is occurring at the
same time violent juvenile crime is skyrocketing. Last year,
youth violent felony filings were up 57% from 2022 and 146% from
2021. Even more telling, of the 46 crimes that recently landed
youth in detention in this facility, over 71% were violent!

If you support my legislation to
ensure violent criminals not get a free pass, you can show your
support by donating HERE.

DONATE TODAY

Friends, I can feel the tide
turning. Seattle politicians are realizing that their attempts
to disparage and defund law enforcement, while looking the other
way and letting violent criminals roam free, has backfired with
devastating consequences for our region.

But we must not let up. I need
your help to keep the momentum up and ensure that the full King
County Council passes my legislation to keep our communities
safe! Will you donate $15, $35, or $75 to my campaign to help me
continue this fight?

I cannot thank you enough for
your support. Together, on the heels of this fantastic news, we
can ensure a safe future for our children!

Reagan Dunn

DONATE NOW

To contribute by personal check,
please make checks payable to "Friends of Reagan Dunn" and send
to: Friends of Reagan Dunn - PO Box 40417 - Bellevue, WA 98015

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com.
If we got your name or any information wrong, we apologize. To
update and correct your information, click here. If you would
like to unsubscribe, click here.

Thank you for supporting Reagan
Dunn's re-election campaign.

name: Nigel4NC
subject: Nigel for Nine Campaign Update
body:
Hello everyone!

I hope this message finds you well! Last week was full of significant
developments for our campaign here in North Carolina's 9th Congressional
District and I'm excited to share some important updates with you.

Vice President Kamala Harris made a memorable visit to Fayetteville on
Thursday, where she energized our supporters and underscored the pivotal
role our district plays in the upcoming election. Her presence highlighted
North Carolina’s role in the 2024 campaign and reinforced the importance of
Democratic values in shaping the future of North Carolina.

Additionally, the NCDP hosted an inspiring Unity Dinner in Raleigh,
featuring former House Speaker Nancy Pelosi. Speaker Pelosi delivered a
powerful message on unity within our party and the urgent need for policies
that address healthcare, economic equity, and education. The dinner sparked
meaningful discussions and reinforced our collective commitment to
advancing progressive values throughout our district.

Looking ahead, we are excited to rally behind Vice President Harris as we
continue to build momentum towards November. Her leadership and dedication
to our shared Democratic principles will guide us forward as we work to
bring positive change to North Carolina.

I am also excited to share that Cason Gaither has officially joined our
team as Campaign Manager. Mr. Gaither comes to us most recently from the
NCDP where he ran the statewide poll observer and voter protection hotline
programs for 2022 and 2023. His deep political knowledge and connections
within the 9th Congressional District will help lead us to victory this
November.

As in all campaigns, your contributions are critical to our success. In
order to build a broad web of support, we are asking our supporters to
contribute $9 and to share this message with 9 friends! 9x9 to flip
District 9! Click here to donate via ActBlue
<https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nigel-bristow-for-congress-1>.

Thank you all for your continued support and engagement. Together, we will
make a difference for our district and our state.

Warm regards,

Nigel Bristow

name: Joe Biden
subject: I'm endorsing Kamala Harris to be the next President of the United States...
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Harris for President
body:
| | |
---
My fellow Americans, Over the past three and a half years, we have made great progress as a nation. Today, America has the strongest economy in the world. We've made historic investments in rebuilding our nation, in lowering prescription drug costs for seniors, and in expanding affordable health care to a record number of Americans. We've provided critically needed care to a million veterans exposed to toxic substances. Passed the first gun safety law in 30 years. Appointed the first African American woman to the Supreme Court. And passed the most significant climate legislation in the history of the world. America has never been better positioned to lead than we are today. I know none of this could have been done without you, the American people. Together, we overcame a once in a century pandemic and the worst economic crisis since the Great Depression. We've protected and preserved our democracy. And we've revitalized and strengthened our alliances around the world. It has been the greatest honor of my life to serve as your President. And while it has been my intention to seek reelection, I believe it is in the best interest of my party and the country for me to stand down and to focus solely on fulfilling my duties as President for the remainder of my term. name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 7/25/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi everyone!
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, July 25, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Anti-Israel agitators burn American flags, accuse Netanyahu of being 'war criminal' as he addresses Congress](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Anti-Israel demonstrators descended on Washington, D.C., on Wednesday ahead of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s address to Congress.
One demonstrator, whose face was covered, was spotted by Fox News carrying what appeared to be the flag of the terrorist group Hamas. Others were heard shouting “allahu Akbar.”
Fox News estimates that a few hundred protesters had gathered on Pennsylvania Avenue and 3rd Street, outside the Gallery of Art. They have a stage set up in front of the Capitol building and are currently chanting.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Ready or not, DNC gives would-be Harris rivals three days to declare, could push for VP pick in a week](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [POLITICO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Vice President Kamala Harris faces a rapidly approaching deadline to secure the Democratic presidential nomination, with potential challengers having only until the upcoming weekend to declare their candidacy.
* The Democratic National Convention's rules committee has set a tight schedule, mandating that all delegate signatures needed for nomination must be collected by August 7th to meet Ohio's ballot access requirements.
* This compressed timeline is designed to solidify Harris' nomination quickly after President Joe Biden withdrew from the race, minimizing legal risks and ensuring that the DNC meets state ballot deadlines. Harris is also expected to announce her running mate by the middle of next week, aligning with the DNC's guidance for completing the virtual roll call.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[In fiery speech to Congress, Netanyahu defends war in Gaza and denounces protesters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [MILITARY.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu defended Israel's war in Gaza and condemned American protesters in a fiery speech to Congress, criticizing the protesters as "useful idiots" for Israel's adversaries.
* Netanyahu's speech, marked by strong applause from some U.S. lawmakers and boycotts by over 50 Democrats, emphasized the necessity of standing with Israel against Hamas, vowing to achieve "total victory" and continue fighting.
* The address highlighted deep divisions within U.S. politics over Israel, with Netanyahu praising former President Donald Trump and criticizing current U.S. policies under President Joe Biden, amid widespread protests and political backlash.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[‘We do not yet have a clear picture of his motive,’ FBI Director Wray says in Trump shooting hearing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE CENTER SQUARE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* FBI Director Christopher Wray testified before the House Judiciary Committee regarding the FBI’s handling of the investigation into the assassination attempt on former President Donald Trump, amid scrutiny over security failures and the resignation of the former Secret Service Director.
* He revealed that the FBI found crude explosive devices and a drone in the shooter's car, which was possibly used for live-streaming before the attack.
* Questions from committee members focused on security lapses at the rally, the shooter's motives, and the actions leading up to the event, with Wray admitting that the FBI still lacks a clear picture of the shooter's motives. The hearing also included broader discussions on the state of national security and the condemnation of political violence.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Prop. 108, the ‘Citizens’ Tax Cut’ plan, could be headed to the ballot with nearly 200k signatures](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Proposition 108, dubbed the Citizens' Tax Cut, which seeks to lower property tax assessment rates in Colorado, has successfully gathered nearly 200,000 signatures, surpassing the required amount by over 75,000, to appear on the November 2024 ballot.
* The initiative, supported by organizations like Advance Colorado and Colorado Concern, proposes to reduce assessment rates to 5.7% for residential and 24% for commercial properties, and limit future tax increases to 4% if passed along with Constitutional Amendment 50.
* Advocates argue that the tax reduction is necessary due to escalating living costs in Colorado, where property taxes have significantly increased, impacting homeowners and small businesses. The measure aims to return tax levels to near those of 2022, cap future increases, and ensure government growth does not outpace taxpayers' wage increases.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[York: Joe Biden owes the country an explanation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), COMMENTARY
_President Joe Biden is scheduled to make a live address to the nation tonight at 9 p.m. That is a violation of his plan “to stop scheduling events after 8 p.m. so that he can get more sleep,” according to news reports earlier this month when he was still struggling to hold on to the Democratic nomination. But it is extremely important that he stay up and tell the public what is going on._
_In the last week, the president, weak and infirm, contracted COVID-19 and went into isolation. There, behind closed doors, he was forced by a group of powerful Democratic insiders to withdraw from the 2024 presidential race. He then endorsed the vice president, Kamala Harris, for the Democratic nomination, and party leaders, despite earlier talk of a mini primary or some other democratic process to choose a new nominee, stampeded to hand Harris the prize within hours of Biden’s decision._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

Hey there,
**My name is Dan Osborn, and I am the candidate running for U.S. Senate against Republican Deb Fischer here in Nebraska.**
I know what you’re thinking. I get a lot of eye rolls when I say the word Nebraska and tell people that I’m running against a Republican. A lot of people don’t think we can win against a two-term incumbent who has an (R) next to her name. But give me the chance to explain why they’re wrong.
The people of Nebraska are ready for change. **The polls show just 24% of Nebraskan voters approve of Republican Deb Fischer – and in one poll, I am LEADING by 2 points! Seriously.**
Nebraskans are fed up with Washington. Both parties – Democrats and Republicans – are full of too many people that have been bought and paid for by corporations and billionaires. The Republicans don’t look out for blue-collar working people like me, and too many Democrats in DC don’t seem to understand rural America anymore.
I’m not rich, and I don’t come from some political dynasty. **I’ve got no business running for the U.S. Senate – and that’s _exactly_ why I am.**
I am a proud card-carrying steamfitter and mechanic. I was president of my local union before I got fired for leading a strike that saved 500 middle-class jobs in Nebraska. I served in the United States Navy and joined the National Guard to help pay for college before I had to drop out so I could keep food on the table for my family.
