**[82-year-old grandmother banned for life,](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2znc1stiijqlacj3q0irf5075g09i7mg1eesu0u7g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cjh66o76clh2bs)****[smeared as bigot for protecting two little girls](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z82h5ps16hckdirocimm9ao0r5p5nhl6ga44ms8o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cjh66o76clh2bs)****[**from man pretending to be a woman**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zrcljs0oijvi3mqtpvuit3u16st51smjo8974hp8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cjh66o76clh2bs)**
---
Dear Fellow Conservative, Today I have an important question to ask you.What would you do if you saw a fully-grown man -- wearing a female bathing suit -- in the locker room watching two little girls undress?I'm going to tell you what our newest client did. And after hearing her story, I hope you'll **[**follow this link right away to help her.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zv9cg7744q402s26pmeilopki37m9tr525hiklng_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cjh66o76clh2bs)** Julie Jaman is an 82-year-old grandmother who's lived in Port Townsend, Washington for almost forty years. She regularly uses her local swimming pool that's owned by the city of Port Townsend and operated by the YMCA. But that all changed in just one afternoon.In case you missed the reporting of this big case on **Fox News** , **Ben Shapiro's Daily Wire** , and numerous other media outlets, here are the details. After her typical swim at the YMCA, Julie went to the women's locker room to shower like she always does.But on this particular day, Julie heard a male voice while she was showering. Alarmed, she pulled back the curtain to see what on earth was going on.That's when she saw a fully-grown man in a women's bathing suit watching two little girls undress. The children appeared to be around four and six years old, and Julie believed she may be witnessing a predator in action.Julie did what any reasonable grandmother would do.She confronted the man and asked him to leave. But instead of putting Julie's concerns to rest, YMCA staff rushed in and began _berating Julie_ for her "discriminatory" response to a man (who "identifies" as a woman) helping little girls undress.Then the YMCA _banned_ Julie from that YMCA for life, the police _kicked her out_ of the building... ...and THEN the YMCA _launched a sophisticated smear campaign_ to paint Julie as a bigot and transphobe in her community.**My fellow patriot, what on earth are we doing as a country when a grandmother trying to protect little girls is turned into public enemy #1?** **The way the YMCA and the city of Port Townsend treated a concerned grandmother isn’t just outrageous -- it's unconstitutional.** Julie Jaman has a _First Amendment_ right to speak her mind no matter who disagrees with it.Just like you do.Julie Jaman has a _Fourteenth Amendment_ right to due process. Just like you do.And that's something the YMCA and the City of Port Townsend neglected when they banned Julie for life without even hearing her side of the story!That's why 82-year-old Julie Jaman is suing the YMCA and the City of Port Townsend. **[And that's why I'm writing to ask for your help today.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zibui0j7kt5jtoulrci9kj1m34hv7k5146umaaa8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cjh66o76clh2bs)** If good and decent people like Julie let radicals bully them into silence (in the face of evil, I might add), more seniors will be censored, more children will be in danger, and twisted radical ideas will become the norm in our country. **[Please help Julie Jaman by making an urgent tax-deductible donation of $25 or more to help Julie fund her court case against the radicals at the YMCA and the city of Port Townsend.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zd2sed86i1envlfvfid2jo0c2p4u6d6oln67kmho_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cjh66o76clh2bs) **Julie never set out to be an "activist."But she became one when she saw that grown man watching two little girls undress in the YMCA locker room.As disgusting and unconstitutional as the facts of this case are, winning won't be easy.Julie Jaman needs you and me to stand with her. My name is Harmeet Dhillon. I'm an attorney and the founder of the _Center from American Liberty_.You may recognize me or my colleagues from our frequent appearances on _Fox News_ , _Newsmax_ , _Tucker Carlson_ , _Fox and Friends_ and others.Together with patriots like you, the _Center for American Liberty_ helps everyday citizens beat the radical Left in court.
---
* We went all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court to get houses of worship reopened and to stop the unconstitutional attacks on people of faith during the Covid lockdowns.
* We've won huge cases protecting parental rights in taxpayer-funded schools.
* And we just won every American the right to pray on the steps of the U.S. Capitol after prayer was forbidden while other gatherings (you can guess what kind) were allowed.

---
**Now we can beat the radicals at the YMCA who want their senior patrons to just go along with their radical cultural shift -- or get out.** It's crazy that 82-year-old Julie Jaman is banned from the YMCA while a fully-grown man in a woman's bathing suit is prancing around the pool with little girls.No doubt, giant left-wing groups like the ACLU will try to join the YMCA's side. With their millions, they can threaten financial ruin for Julie. And they can shame and humiliate her in her community. Today you have a choice to do nothing and let them get away with it. Or you can help Julie Jaman fight back for all the seniors who are tired of being shut up and shut out._And_ fight for all the children who are victims of the left's evil and radical ideology. **[**Please follow this link right now to make your tax-deductible donation of $25 right away.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zbddmad8pdu1ro2j3jhd09p26k4dgghnvfep5f08_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cjh66o76clh2bs)** And if you can give more today -- say $35, $50, $100, $250, or more -- please do it. The YMCA and the city of Port Townsend are going to have giant left-wing groups in the fight.But I know the _Center for American Liberty_ can win this if we all stick together. We've done it before and we can do it again. Please join us.

Dear Fellow Believers,
As we approach the upcoming election, it is crucial for us as Christians to prayerfully consider our choices. We should vote for candidates who uphold biblical values, demonstrate integrity, and are committed to protecting religious freedoms. By supporting leaders who align with our faith principles, we can ensure that our nation continues to reflect the moral and ethical standards that are foundational to our beliefs. Let us seek God's guidance and wisdom in making informed and conscientious decisions at the polls. There is only one candidate running for President who aligns with christians on the major issues!!! That is Donald Trump!!

Fellow Patriot, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Fellow Patriot, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=7c2e7b9df7854ed2b3b7c41aaac6a1a1&_e=Sl6mo3ayaJNLNUdhFVcBafOLVBxUSqowfdzzCr3AAQGE1oYf7J2V9lkOCSxz6shHSbhovbPvXothNMk-hzx1PhHb-iPIp0dEKVC9cIKcvisf3FnjhsXxmu9aBm85Sk3gMUUQi6FyfuGhKlXAYFK5RWFTFtRWwbkpzu8U1PG7vKdlWGSPZBZrTNeH5wVfW6r8Dk1-ZhqlBqD8qGAzAxsmEjGAaedAuMtBrBIjhbyePr9LxWz9PvPuTjrfK7InrCZCQcpZFJVBhGfIVIYawde84EU2-rUB_PazaeFXsKMUxlIorL9l6ynvUJpLMdto1PnP)_

Fellow Patriot, I'm proud to say that _Right Wing Revolution_ is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before:
* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

* It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

* It's NOT a call for __ our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on __ how _all Americans_ can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving _ourselves_.

**I want to get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as possible --which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover edition for FREE.** _**[All I ask for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again!](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=7c2e7b9df7854ed2b3b7c41aaac6a1a1&_e=Sl6mo3ayaJNLNUdhFVcBafOLVBxUSqowfdzzCr3AAQGE1oYf7J2V9lkOCSxz6shHSbhovbPvXothNMk-hzx1PhHb-iPIp0dEKVC9cIKcvisf3FnjhsXxmu9aBm85Sk3gMUUQi6FyfuGhKlXAYFK5RW0y2MJF183BbOD9ygKCNJ9qfH7vHzNZ-vILj6832pZXWf1wZkVCYmUw-kty_yI4Ga5dTMcer5cppFaatS7xnKnFz6Um4LkjOpMDzGYOmwo6SwyIk724xIo9aLkdWB5W9bZC_YmS21WUH3gsGSCXYNBVIGBfp9VEz34RdCgjialE)**_

clean_body: How we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives—for the better. | | | Fellow Patriot, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--for the better. Fellow Patriot, over the past year, I wrote my new book,Right Wing Revolution,as a guide for a return to an America where ... We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness. We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution. We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal. We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night. We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans. Fellow Patriot, I'm proud to say that Right Wing Revolution is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before: It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right. It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American. It's NOT a call for our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on how all Americans can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving ourselves. I want to get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as possible --which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover edition for FREE. In this defining moment for America's future, let's come together in a spirit of FREEDOM and with a firm belief in AMERICAN GREATNESS to find all that's possible in the days ahead. Thank YOU for your patriotism, moral courage, and continued support of Turning Point USA. For America, Charlie Kirk Founder & CEO Turning Point USA 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

| Good afternoon!

As a valued supporter of our mission, I am reaching out to you with a matter of utmost urgency and importance.

# Women’s health is under unprecedented attack.

Across the country, we are witnessing a systematic dismantling of the rights and protections that have safeguarded women’s health for decades. From restrictive legislation that limits access to essential reproductive health services, to budget cuts that undermine vital health programs, the stakes have never been higher and new data shows women are suffering the most in southern states including Georgia.

These efforts are not just political—they are personal. They affect our mothers, sisters, daughters, and friends. They threaten the progress we have fought so hard to achieve and put at risk the health and well-being of countless women. Now, more than ever, we need to stand united. We need to amplify our voices and mobilize our resources to protect women’s health and rights.

I am so glad vice president and likely democratic nominee, Kamala Harris, shares my view and has been a passionate and outspoken supporter of the importance of making the health of women a priority.

Your support has always been the backbone of our efforts, and today, we need you more than ever. Here’s how you can help:

1\. **[Donate:](https://lizjohnsonforus.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4a0fd0913238344008dfe952&id=37eaee947b&e=e8eaba4639)** Your financial contributions allow us to fund critical programs, provide direct services, and advocate for policy changes. Every dollar makes a difference.

2\. **Advocate:** Use your voice to speak for the rights of women. Contact your representatives, participate in rallies, and share our message on social media.

3\. **Engage:** Stay informed and engaged with our organization. Attend our events, volunteer your time, and encourage others to join our cause.

### **I am working on some exciting events where we can gather together to make our collective voices known on this issue- STAY TUNED!**

Together, we can ensure that women have the health care they deserve. Your unwavering support is crucial in this fight, and we are deeply grateful for your commitment to this cause. Thank you for standing with us and for women everywhere.

With determination and appreciation,
Liz

clean_body: | | | | | | Good afternoon! As a valued supporter of our mission, I am reaching out to you with a matter of utmost urgency and importance. Women’s health is under unprecedented attack. Across the country, we are witnessing a systematic dismantling of the rights and protections that have safeguarded women’s health for decades. From restrictive legislation that limits access to essential reproductive health services, to budget cuts that undermine vital health programs, the stakes have never been higher and new data shows women are suffering the most in southern states including Georgia. These efforts are not just political—they are personal. They affect our mothers, sisters, daughters, and friends. They threaten the progress we have fought so hard to achieve and put at risk the health and well-being of countless women. Now, more than ever, we need to stand united. We need to amplify our voices and mobilize our resources to protect women’s health and rights. I am so glad vice president and likely democratic nominee, Kamala Harris, shares my view and has been a passionate and outspoken supporter of the importance of making the health of women a priority. Your support has always been the backbone of our efforts, and today, we need you more than ever. Here’s how you can help: 1\. Your financial contributions allow us to fund critical programs, provide direct services, and advocate for policy changes. Every dollar makes a difference. 2\. Advocate: Use your voice to speak for the rights of women. Contact your representatives, participate in rallies, and share our message on social media. 3\. Engage: Stay informed and engaged with our organization. Attend our events, volunteer your time, and encourage others to join our cause. I am working on some exciting events where we can gather together to make our collective voices known on this issue- STAY TUNED! Together, we can ensure that women have the health care they deserve. Your unwavering support is crucial in this fight, and we are deeply grateful for your commitment to this cause. Thank you for standing with us and for women everywhere. body:
It’s going to take a huge team effort to build the biggest possible movement to defeat Donald Trump in November. | | | Peter, I wanted to break the news to you myself: **The Working Families Party is endorsing Vice President Kamala Harris for president.** Our members, chapters, and party leaders have made their voices heard and voted _overwhelmingly_ to support Kamala Harris as the next Democratic nominee — with 95% of the total vote in favor of endorsement. We are living in uncertain times. But we do know this: we cannot let Donald Trump and MAGA extremists return to power. Four years ago we played a major role in organizing and mobilizing the voters to oust Trump. This year, we’re prepared to defeat his movement once and for all. Electing Kamala Harris as President is one step — one _important_ step — toward our goal of winning power for working people and building a government responsive to all of us, not just the wealthy few. **But it’s going to take a huge team effort to build the biggest possible movement to defeat Donald Trump in November.** **[If you can, please split a donation between Kamala Harris and the Working Families Party’s general election fund today to help kickstart our efforts to turn out voters in races up and down the ballot this fall.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9WEUuRPT5pgXDj5rE89Co8HfaXmSHgt99Cl4OlsZdMaEWfx5MoL_8xXB2jZZWS2okLioB2KcdOzPHiQSUTQlhwJBBs0Y7QZyi5UU7FvNgy0qjxUf94loOX1t5WgBViANFqU6-27lPcqM_Aick_xizJalEdKbpSslAS6FMg88doGyZaMFtHWMcztUBJ4vGpSwzY9AojzZMbGS8oovPedM8VND5CzPYKY9Lgcra8kDABW_8TisWAA3Bkau55BLK1K9goVKVS3Rn-3TEmtD_GOBhTaSUc4G9oVdz8bbLR2x1aRSsuHd-uuGxmW1LKriMthgJisRFVLHbAE5bdBBm2vh26RGCpo2U4dz_uuWXi2TEhvzBljFGO8L9Po_sdHIt8ZMg-xez4-8YsNX0f_rvsRx9ew/48c/BSfDjHk6SmOscQdojIl2cw/h0/h001.lPTOwLk3Hn_wt8H5xxRZDf4KKalcn4SXllBCBHIkU1E)** No matter the amount, every single dollar makes a difference as we double down on our efforts to stop Trump’s authoritarian movement in its tracks and elect Vice President Kamala Harris as the next President of the United States. **[Pitch in $10 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9WEUuRPT5pgXDj5rE89Co8HfaXmSHgt99Cl4OlsZdMaHbcOP5MOkNcv9jkT5szUb-jwbnvtDsZQ68AbvWH8uW4_40tYTybOPjN-t237LtrLdfQQizzX52hyrxw8s8iLGXC8G8Yf4q-XdeQaVR-nQfIx_BWiiBoEF7NQWZGS4036qvbmPERvMJ4JmAYMizDPcxaouyZERXqxq8HtyLF3Wr6WmwmQ-HSXJVSNj1VxVZlWf3L9Mf15SLev7pujlpVx2fpAnaNgv1lIDihpUrrKJ4rl3S-Hjlm3aibayREtRjEjh08EvONBLiHFGPFl9yOkj6Sb9Cba8q-coDsR9Si6UhYQoAgfN1t_O-rxe3d1zrGA7yatoY-7TrQxx33dpNV37y3b_7TPOJLgDUHJ-pktp9QQ/48c/BSfDjHk6SmOscQdojIl2cw/h1/h001.bRASGCRCTcghpnx8bReuoFs2kClqJzNUEINhVax5pcU)** Imagine the possibility of winning policies that make real, concrete improvements in people’s lives. Like taxing the rich to bring down the cost of housing and child care. Or raising wages for workers and making it easier for them to organize their workplaces. Imagine a House majority with a growing group of WFP leaders fighting every day for our values. That’s not just possible — it’s happening. Year after year, cycle after cycle, the ranks of WFP champions in Congress are growing. If we continue to build our power, before too long, it’ll be WFP leaders setting the agenda in city halls, state houses, and Washington, DC. **It’s all possible — but it won’t be under a Trump presidency.** Under Trump, we’ll be left playing defense and trying to deflect the worst of his attacks against our communities. To have a shot at a working families agenda, we’ve got to win at the top of the ticket. We also know that our movement must give people something to vote _for,_ not just vote against, by laying out a vision for a country where everyone has health care, everyone has clean air and food, and everyone can afford quality housing. clean_body: It’s going to take a huge team effort to build the biggest possible movement to defeat Donald Trump in November. | | | Peter, I wanted to break the news to you myself: The Working Families Party is endorsing Vice President Kamala Harris for president. Our members, chapters, and party leaders have made their voices heard and voted overwhelmingly to support Kamala Harris as the next Democratic nominee — with 95% of the total vote in favor of endorsement. We are living in uncertain times. But we do know this: we cannot let Donald Trump and MAGA extremists return to power. Four years ago we played a major role in organizing and mobilizing the voters to oust Trump. This year, we’re prepared to defeat his movement once and for all. Electing Kamala Harris as President is one step — one important step — toward our goal of winning power for working people and building a government responsive to all of us, not just the wealthy few. But it’s going to take a huge team effort to build the biggest possible movement to defeat Donald Trump in November. No matter the amount, every single dollar makes a difference as we double down on our efforts to stop Trump’s authoritarian movement in its tracks and elect Vice President Kamala Harris as the next President of the United States. Imagine the possibility of winning policies that make real, concrete improvements in people’s lives. Like taxing the rich to bring down the cost of housing and child care. Or raising wages for workers and making it easier for them to organize their workplaces. Imagine a House majority with a growing group of WFP leaders fighting every day for our values. That’s not just possible — it’s happening. Year after year, cycle after cycle, the ranks of WFP champions in Congress are growing. If we continue to build our power, before too long, it’ll be WFP leaders setting the agenda in city halls, state houses, and Washington, DC. It’s all possible — but it won’t be under a Trump presidency. Under Trump, we’ll be left playing defense and trying to deflect the worst of his attacks against our communities. To have a shot at a working families agenda, we’ve got to win at the top of the ticket. Our endorsement of Vice President Harris doesn’t mean that we’ll never disagree with her, or never have contrasting views on policy. This election, however, is bigger than any one person. It’s about what kind of country we want to be and whether we will let the rights and freedoms that our ancestors fought for — the right to vote without discrimination, to love who we love, and to control our own bodies — be taken away from us. We also know that our movement must give people something to vote for, not just vote against, by laying out a vision for a country where everyone has health care, everyone has clean air and food, and everyone can afford quality housing. Defeating the far-right and electing Kamala Harris is a political necessity, but it’s not a final destination. No matter the outcome of this election, we will continue to organize — community by community, neighborhood by neighborhood — to create the beautiful future we want for our children and families. Training volunteers, phone banking and texting, and knocking on doors requires crucial resources, and your support today will allow us to reach and turn out voters in critical swing states and demographic groups. In solidarity, Maurice Mitchell National Director Working Families Party P.S. _Me and my sisters when we were (much) younger_
Peter —

When I think back to the most difficult experiences in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a strong support system to get me to the other side.

Sleeping on the floor in our apartment growing up because we couldn’t afford a bed wasn’t easy.

Working to make ends meet while I was trying to get into a good school wasn’t easy.

Serving in Iraq in one of the hardest hit units of the entire war definitely wasn’t easy.

And running for the U.S. Senate — having Kari Lake attack me day in, day out, while Trump helps her raise millions to smear my name... that hasn’t been easy either.

But as a kid, I had my family.

Getting into school and building a better life, I had a strong community supporting me.

Getting through Iraq, I had my brothers watching my back.

And in this campaign, I have you.

Simply put... I couldn’t do this without your support, FIRST. When you woke up this morning, you probably didn’t think it’d be the day you made a donation to my campaign, but I really need you if we’re going to defeat Kari Lake and defend Arizona and control of the U.S. Senate.

clean_body: When I think back to the most difficult experiences in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a strong support system to get me to the other side. | = Me and my sisters when we were (much) younger Peter — When I think back to the most difficult experiences in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a strong support system to get me to the other side. Sleeping on the floor in our apartment growing up because we couldn’t afford a bed wasn’t easy. Working to make ends meet while I was trying to get into a good school wasn’t easy. Serving in Iraq in one of the hardest hit units of the entire war definitely wasn’t easy. And running for the U.S. Senate — having Kari Lake attack me day in, day out, while Trump helps her raise millions to smear my name... that hasn’t been easy either. But as a kid, I had my family. Getting into school and building a better life, I had a strong community supporting me. Getting through Iraq, I had my brothers watching my back. And in this campaign, I have you. Simply put... I couldn’t do this without your support, FIRST. When you woke up this morning, you probably didn’t think it’d be the day you made a donation to my campaign, but I really need you if we’re going to defeat Kari Lake and defend Arizona and control of the U.S. Senate. = | = | = | = | = | = I know you hear this a lot, but seriously: Thank you for being a part of this team. I am honored to have the President’s endorsement and my intention is to earn and win this nomination.

We can choose the dark path of Project 2025, with less freedom and more division. Or we can choose to pull together and do the work — For The People.
****These are not ordinary times. And this will not be an ordinary election. But this is our America. And I need you with me in this fight. So, I have to ask:****

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89532192/487609661/1174061679?refcode=header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzU2ZTcyNmEtOTE0YS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=I3Y91tqdjLGRdp19OL6txkxG9jXmeVbvKxP1flvl8uQ=) | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89532193/487609662/-1105102591?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzU2ZTcyNmEtOTE0YS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=I3Y91tqdjLGRdp19OL6txkxG9jXmeVbvKxP1flvl8uQ=&emci=a36ce2fb-054a-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=756e726a-914a-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=22982885) Peter, I’ve reached out over the past few weeks about some microaggressions and a racist push poll in our primary, **but this treatment of our fellow DNC delegate last night by a fellow Democrat really takes the cake.** Calling someone an @$$hole on a DNC Delegate Zoom because they’re speaking on behalf of the Arab-American community is _**flat-out unacceptable**_.**And the fact that no elected officials on the call immediately condemned this behavior is the elephant in the room.** While I am not Arab-American, I have also experienced many of the same sentiments as a Black woman running as a pro-ceasefire Democrat against two pro-Israel Democrats in the primary for the open, toss-up seat in Michigan’s 8th District. And the fact nobody spoke up in defense of Abbas indicates we need a more diverse slate of elected officials who understand the lived experience of a person of color, not the privileged few. If we are expected to shut up on one issue, then who knows how long until we can’t speak on any issue that affects marginalized communities like mine – Black folks in Detroit, Saginaw, and Flint? **That's why I urge Kamala Harris to engage with these uncommitted delegates in a constructive, respectful dialogue. No one should ever feel their voice doesn't matter. Such behavior is simply unacceptable, and whoever made the comment should feel deeply ashamed of themselves.** **[Peter, will you join me in calling on President Harris to meet with Michigan’s Uncommitted Delegates to include their voices in our Big Tent Party? Sign your name here to demand that our Democratic Party leadership and Presidential Nominee (who was last on the record as being pro-ceasefire) listen to Arab-American voices in Michigan. Not only because it’s the right thing to do but also because, without their votes, we may lose the presidency here in a crucial swing state. Sign on now; we are trying to gather 1,000 signatures before midnight →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89532194/487609663/-1105102591?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzU2ZTcyNmEtOTE0YS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=I3Y91tqdjLGRdp19OL6txkxG9jXmeVbvKxP1flvl8uQ=&emci=a36ce2fb-054a-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=756e726a-914a-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=22982885)** _When they don't like what we have to say, they just tell us to shut up and expect obedience. It all began with the censoring of my dear colleague and sister, Rep. Rashida Tlaib. Now, more Arab-American activists who simply advocate for Palestinians’ basic human rights are being silenced. If the heartbreaking trauma experienced by children in Gaza is difficult for some to simply hear about, imagine enduring it day in and day out..._ Yup, sit with that for a minute. I’m pretty used to the type of treatment and microagressions that Abbas experienced last night. **My opponent Kristin McDonald Rivet has consistently thrown microaggressions my way (intentional or not), accusing me of trying to divide our party instead of uniting us whenever I bring up my pro-ceasefire stance.** **They tried to shut my compatriot Abbas down, but what they didn't know is that all pro-ceasefire supporters have a voice through our campaign, and it is one I am not afraid to use while all eyes are on our primary election in just 12 more days.** So it’s time to to stand together behind our Arab-American brothers and sisters and bring a megaphone to their voices, and get some things straight. **[Peter, your support is crucial; help us ensure we can amplify our voices with multiple megaphones across every corner of our district, Michigan, and the entire country. Please sign on to my letter to Vice President Harris and Democratic Party Leadership urging them to meet with Michigan’s Uncommitted Delegates and bring them into our big tent instead of marginalizing the 700,000 voices who voted uncommitted around the country and here in Michigan to speak out on behalf of Arab-American voices who were being silenced.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89532195/487609664/-1105102591?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzU2ZTcyNmEtOTE0YS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=I3Y91tqdjLGRdp19OL6txkxG9jXmeVbvKxP1flvl8uQ=&emci=a36ce2fb-054a-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=756e726a-914a-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=22982885)** Saginaw County has been a deciding factor in the last two Presidential Elections and this year will be no different. Lets send a strong message to Congress that Michigan wants a representative who works on the most pressing issues in Michigan and fights for the rights that are important to us. Not one that will be silent when told to shut up and called an @$$hole. Our freedoms are interconnected, and we must stand united against those who seek to silence us with ridicule. So, let's raise our voices, and let's refuse to be silenced. [**Join us in this crucial fight for justice and equality by signing on toda** y →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89532196/487609665/-1105102591?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzU2ZTcyNmEtOTE0YS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=I3Y91tqdjLGRdp19OL6txkxG9jXmeVbvKxP1flvl8uQ=&emci=a36ce2fb-054a-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=756e726a-914a-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=22982885) In solidarity, – Dr. Pamela Pugh |
* * *
_I’m Dr. Pamela Pugh, and I’m a Saginaw native running for Congress in Michigan's 8th District. I've spent my career fighting to improve the lives of Michigan residents through public health initiatives, and as the Chief Public Health Advisor for Flint I played a pivotal role in standing alongside Flint residents during the water crisis. As a public servant, I currently serve as the President of the Michigan State Board of Education, a statewide elected position. I believe in standing up for the people and fighting for our democracy, our children, and our future._ _**I've lived in Michigan's 8th District for my entire life and it will be the honor of a lifetime to represent my community in the House of Representatives. My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as _"Wyoming's doctor,"_ but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.

name: Neil Parrott
subject: Answers
body:
When you want to know what something is REALLY like, you go to the source. When you want answers, you find someone who has been there.Tonight, you | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=45d99419b9)
---
| |
---
| Peter,

Do you want answers to what is going on in the political world right now?

When you want to know what something is REALLY like, you go to the source. When you want answers, you find someone who has been there.

**Tonight, you have that opportunity. **

Congressman Andy Harris has seen a lot. As Chairman of the Appropriation subcommittee on Agriculture, Rural Development, Food and Drug Administration, **_just imagine what he has debated in DC._**

He’s also a member of the Labor, Health and Human Services, Education and **Homeland Security** Appropriations subcommittee, so think about those discussions in DC.

You have the chance to talk with Congressman Harris and hear first-hand about government spending, who is deciding what, and... our border.

**You want answers? Join us tonight in Walkersville.**

__From 5:30pm-6:30pm we will hold a VIP reception with Congressman Harris, then from 6:30pm-8:30pm we’ll enjoy good food and hear from Congressman Harris.__ Hosted by Vernon and Cynthia King at 8323 Water Street Road, Walkersville. RSVP by clicking below, or you can register at the door.
**Please join us!**
---
| [Sign Up to Join Congressman Harris and Neil Parrott Tonight, 7/25](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=f3f819f3d9&e=5a45ee1154 "Sign Up to Join Congressman Harris and Neil Parrott Tonight, 7/25")

| I am honored to have Congressman Harris’ support. He has endorsed my campaign for US Congress, and I plan to work for YOU.

We must close our southern border - and I will fight for that on day one.

We must reduce the cost of living - families have to be able to feed their children and heat their homes. Those on a fixed-income cannot afford this extreme level of inflation.

We must stop “special interest” spending - a national debt in the trillions eventually becomes unpayable - then what?

**We must stop the pointless, divisive political rhetoric and get to work on what we CAN fix...what most Americans agree on. ** We don’t have another year to waste!

| You won't want to miss tonight's event.

Congressman Andy Harris was first elected to Maryland’s 1st Congressional District in 2010 flipping it from a seat briefly held by a Democrat. Dr. Andy Harris was a physician at the Johns Hopkins Hospital, a medical officer in the Naval Reserve, and a state senator before coming to Congress.

Andy is the proud father of five children, stepfather of one, and grandfather to ten. Andy lives with his wife, Nicole, and their dog in Dorchester County. In his free time, he enjoys spending time on the Chesapeake Bay with his family and repairing old cars with his sons.

I hope that you will join me, my wife April, and Congressman Harris tonight in Walkersville. There is no time like the present to get involved and to make a difference.

Let’s get those answers and get to work. Hope to see you tonight.

For our country,
Neil

subject: Now what? 🤔
body:
Together with Kamala Harris | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/25dd4c32f829/now-what?e=0f456155ff)
---
[](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=1b2fab4f46&e=0f456155ff)
|
# Future President Harris!
---
| Peter,

Patti Hewitt, our champion for Coastal Georgia, has proudly endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris for President. As we face critical times, Patti’s vision aligns perfectly with Harris’s commitment to justice, equality, and the well-being of all Americans.

**Why This Matters to Us in Coastal Georgia

** Patti has predicted three key strengths of a Kamala Harris Presidency that will significantly impact our communities:
* **Healthcare Access and Maternal Mortality:** Georgia’s maternal mortality rate is alarmingly high, especially in our rural areas. A Harris Presidency promises affordable, high-quality healthcare for every family in Coastal Georgia. This includes life-saving standards for maternal care, ensuring our mothers receive the best possible care.

* **Economic Revitalization:** Kamala Harris’s policies will invigorate local economies and support small businesses. This means more resources, more opportunities, and a brighter future for Coastal Georgia. From expanding access to capital to championing small businesses, Harris’s vision is our vision.

* **Middle-Class Tax Relief:** Tax policies under Harris could bring much-needed relief to our middle-class families. With her history of advocating for tax credits and fair tax policies, we can expect support that directly benefits hardworking families in our district.

**Take Action Now!**
* **Follow Us on Social Media:** Stay updated and spread the word. Click to follow us on [Facebook](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=820301fb54&e=0f456155ff) and [Instagram](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=d23f59c855&e=0f456155ff).
* **Volunteer with Us:** Your time and effort can make a huge difference. [Sign up to volunteer and help us reach more voters.](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=49afe9510e&e=0f456155ff)
* **Support Our Campaign:** Your donations fuel our fight for a better future. [Donate to help us continue our work.](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=5950fbecf4&e=0f456155ff)
* **Forward This Email:** Share this exciting news with friends, family, and neighbors. Let’s build a strong community of supporters.
* **Get Out and Vote:** Encourage everyone you know to vote. Your voice matters, and together, we can make a change. [**The deadline to register to vote is Monday, October 7, 2024.**](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=2a154bfce7&e=0f456155ff) And **early voting begins October 14th and ends November 1st.** [Don’t forget, **absentee voting is available until October 28th and no excuse is required.**](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=2845625d75&e=0f456155ff)

**Patti Hewitt and Kamala Harris represent the power of women’s leadership and the diversity of our communities.** Let’s support a future where leadership reflects the people it serves. Join us in building a brighter, more inclusive future for Coastal Georgia.

Thank you for your unwavering support. **When we fight, we win!**

Our July primary is getting closer every day, and IMMEDIATE support is required if I am to continue. Here's why I'm counting on you to be one of the 5% who takes action and responds ASAP: 1\. Ever since Donald Trump endorsed me, the Radical Left has been launching hundreds of thousands of dollars in ad blitzes against me. 2\. The Left is planning to further dismantle fundamental American freedoms and values. 3\. I'm falling behind schedule on my fundraising goals, and the Right cannot afford to show ANY weakness against the Radical Leftists. My campaign is fueled by grassroots donors who chip in as little as $1 at a time. | With less than 5% of people responding, I can't continue the fight to restore America's greatness. Will you prove your devotion to strengthening America today by helping me continue my fight? The road ahead is difficult and will be full of Leftist attacks. The entire MAGA movement is under attack. I need to hear from my supporters - and I need more than 5% to respond. I don't want this to be the end of the road. body:

|

| Peter, **_BREAKING NEWS!_** Two weeks ago, in a historic legal victory, Moms for Liberty achieved a significant breakthrough against the overreach of federal regulations,**halting President Biden's attempt to rewrite Title IX in schools across the nation.** This landmark decision stops the implementation of rules that would redefine 'sex' to include gender identity—**a change that jeopardizes both the educational environment and our rights as parents.**
Since this victory, the legal team at Moms for Liberty has worked tirelessly to expand the scope of this protection. **Today, we bring to you some FANTASTIC BREAKING NEWS!** A judge just clarified the ruling to include all current and future members of Moms for Liberty, **granting unlimited protection to schools attended by children of any member of Moms for Liberty,_regardless of state._**

As we listened to the voices from across our great country, from all walks of life, the RNC has articulated a clear and compelling vision: an America where unity, freedom, and opportunity flourish. Through a series of heartfelt speeches and powerful testimonies, the convention painted a picture of a nation that thrives when we stand together, undivided by the forces seeking to pull us apart. Our strength lies in our solidarity, in our capacity to work together to overcome the obstacles that lie ahead. Let us continue to stand together, championing the values that make America exceptional. Our combined efforts are crucial as we strive to protect the freedoms that define us and pursue the prosperity that awaits us. Your involvement is key. If you haven't already, take action today by joining us in the Common Sense Club as we uphold the true American spirit of unity and progress, ensuring that President Trump’s vision for a united America prevails in 2024. For Unity, For America. With steadfast dedication, The Common Sense Action Team

body:
Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never could’ve guessed this is how things would turn out. When I was a Marine in Iraq, I never could’ve guessed that I’d have to fight to defend our democracy at home. |
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89538734/487623500/-1397648958?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_EOM_AC90_20240725_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWY4Yzk1YWUtOTg0YS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=jnbC3W_oVizFArqPwb4PXW74EvtxFIzgrW4MufiEpNY=)
---
Hola, my friend. It’s Ruben. You might be wondering how this kid... [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89538735/487623501/1669863775?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_EOM_AC90_20240725_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWY4Yzk1YWUtOTg0YS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=jnbC3W_oVizFArqPwb4PXW74EvtxFIzgrW4MufiEpNY=) ...ended up here, running for U.S. Senate, in one of the most competitive races in the entire country. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89538736/487623502/1669863775?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_EOM_AC90_20240725_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWY4Yzk1YWUtOTg0YS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=jnbC3W_oVizFArqPwb4PXW74EvtxFIzgrW4MufiEpNY=) Well, it started back in the apartment I shared with my mom and my sisters after our dad left. It was tough. I was sleeping on the floor because that’s all we could afford. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89538738/487623503/1669863775?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_EOM_AC90_20240725_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWY4Yzk1YWUtOTg0YS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=jnbC3W_oVizFArqPwb4PXW74EvtxFIzgrW4MufiEpNY=) I knew I had to do whatever it took to build a better life for us. I worked a bunch of jobs all through school to help make ends meet. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89538740/487623504/1669863775?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_EOM_AC90_20240725_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWY4Yzk1YWUtOTg0YS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=jnbC3W_oVizFArqPwb4PXW74EvtxFIzgrW4MufiEpNY=) Thanks to my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into college. But before I graduated, I enlisted in the Marines to serve the country that gave me so much. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89538742/487623505/1669863775?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_EOM_AC90_20240725_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWY4Yzk1YWUtOTg0YS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=jnbC3W_oVizFArqPwb4PXW74EvtxFIzgrW4MufiEpNY=) I deployed to Al Anbar, Iraq with my brothers in arms. They called us “Lucky Lima”, but our luck turned eventually. We ended up the hardest Marine hit unit of the entire Iraq war, and I lost some of my best friends over there. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89538744/487623506/1669863775?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_EOM_AC90_20240725_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWY4Yzk1YWUtOTg0YS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=jnbC3W_oVizFArqPwb4PXW74EvtxFIzgrW4MufiEpNY=) You’re never the same person after something like that. And I knew I had to do something to improve things for the guys I served with, for people who grew up like me. So, I ended up running for Congress — and I won. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89538746/487623507/1669863775?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_EOM_AC90_20240725_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWY4Yzk1YWUtOTg0YS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=jnbC3W_oVizFArqPwb4PXW74EvtxFIzgrW4MufiEpNY=) Then, on January 6th, everything changed. It became clear to me that public service wasn’t just about improving the lives of the people in my community anymore — it was about defending our democracy, too. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89538748/487623508/1669863775?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_EOM_AC90_20240725_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWY4Yzk1YWUtOTg0YS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=jnbC3W_oVizFArqPwb4PXW74EvtxFIzgrW4MufiEpNY=) So now, I’m running for U.S. Senate. My opponent Kari Lake continues to spread the same lies and conspiracies that caused January 6th in the first place, and she’s one of the greatest threats to our democracy — after Trump himself. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89538749/487623509/1669863775?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_EOM_AC90_20240725_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWY4Yzk1YWUtOTg0YS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=jnbC3W_oVizFArqPwb4PXW74EvtxFIzgrW4MufiEpNY=) Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never would’ve guessed this is how things would turn out. When I was a Marine in Iraq, I never would’ve thought I’d have to fight to defend our democracy at home. When I launched my first campaign, I never would’ve imagined that hundreds of thousands of people would back me up and donate to support me, either. And I never, ever would’ve thought I’d need to ask supporters like you, people who have already done so much, to do a bit more. But to defeat Kari Lake and win in Arizona, that’s what I have to do. I need you to do a bit more. **[Please — if you can afford to make a split donation of $24 or anything you can to my campaign and the Arizona Democratic Party, it would mean the world. You might be wondering how this kid... = ...ended up here, running for U.S. Senate, in one of the most competitive races in the entire country. = Well, it started back in the apartment I shared with my mom and my sisters after our dad left. It was tough. I was sleeping on the floor because that’s all we could afford. = I knew I had to do whatever it took to build a better life for us. I worked a bunch of jobs all through school to help make ends meet. = Thanks to my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into college. But before I graduated, I enlisted in the Marines to serve the country that gave me so much. = I deployed to Al Anbar, Iraq with my brothers in arms. They called us “Lucky Lima”, but our luck turned eventually. We ended up the hardest Marine hit unit of the entire Iraq war, and I lost some of my best friends over there. = You’re never the same person after something like that. And I knew I had to do something to improve things for the guys I served with, for people who grew up like me. So, I ended up running for Congress — and I won. = Then, on January 6th, everything changed. It became clear to me that public service wasn’t just about improving the lives of the people in my community anymore — it was about defending our democracy, too. = So now, I’m running for U.S. Senate. Peter, We’ll get right to the chase: we need your help.

**Right now, CAPT Hung Cao is SOARING in the polls alongside President Trump in Virginia.**

He’s building momentum in our Commonwealth that no political “expert” thought was possible.

Friend, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Friend, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

Hey, everybody. It’s Mark Kelly.
I’ve got two things for you.
**First:** It’s clear that Democrats are fired up and ready to elect Kamala Harris this year. But we can’t wait until November to start putting in the work.
I ran two of the toughest, most competitive campaigns in the country in 2020 and 2022. Those races taught me some important lessons. When it feels like everything is going right, you can’t let that distract you from the mission. When it feels like everything is going wrong, you have to trust yourself, trust your team, and work your way to a solution.
We can do difficult things. We can win this election. But anything can happen, so we’ve got to make the most of every single day between now and then.

You can bet I’m going to be giving it my all to elect pro-Democracy candidates up and down the ballot — both here in Arizona and across the country.

body:
https://www.perelesformissouri.com/ [https://www.perelesformissouri.com/]
Peter,
CNBC recently released its list of “America’s 10 worst states to live and work in for 2024,” and alarm bells should be going off. The toxic MAGA agenda being pushed in states like Missouri and across the country—particularly Project 2025 , the Trump campaign’s disturbing blueprint for America’s future—is dragging us down.
The CNBC report gives Missouri an "F" for Quality of Life and Workforce. But the reasons why Missouri is ranked so low overall should give us pause: Missouri’s near-total abortion ban, which has no exceptions for rape or incest and only a vague and confusing exception for the “life of the mother,” was a huge factor. Crime, and oppressive voting restrictions, also weighed heavily in the poor ranking.
After over 20 years of Republican control of Missouri, we have a lot of work to do to turn things around.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=cnbc-rankings_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=cnbc-rankings_image]
The frustrating thing about report cards like these is that there are common sense solutions that people of any political party can support—but progress is constantly thwarted by extremists who cause chaos and dysfunction if they don’t get exactly what they want.
And the things that the extremists demand are deeply unpopular: defunding public schools and libraries; draconian abortion bans with zero exceptions; outlawing contraception and widely used fertility treatments like in vitro fertilization (IVF); and flooding the streets with guns, making it even harder for our law enforcement officers to keep us safe.
We should not be held hostage to an extremist agenda that flouts majority rule and rolls back the freedoms and personal rights that we have fought for and gained over the last 100 years.
The status quo here doesn’t have to be failure. It doesn’t have to be coming up last in every measure of quality of life. We can change things and turn our state around: We Can Do Better.
Flipping this seat is essential to ending the chaos and extremism that hold us back. But Joe is going to need an outpouring of grassroots support from all of us to win so that he can go to Jefferson City and fight for us. If you are able, can you contribute any amount to help keep this campaign strong and on the path to victory in November? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=cnbc-rankings]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=cnbc-rankings_donate]
Thank you for your support and for fighting for a better future for everyone in Missouri.
-Team Pereles for Missouri

body:
And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--for the better.

| | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=db189ff0c10e49b69f441e3a5dc55612&_e=gk_eXUelJMQL2U16O614ihwznnvaRRE7Edxn8D-VwW89VjMpAbkESjb3SDOg2sOQs6DilveX8u9DL1xpvn1UgzMifxg90N_ppLe-cru-kJFyETEdqiZ28S2grBjQSTbSmG3CCsm5aiGA0HjaGdHyVREOS-bBK1eJkX936AbCXbGe_GbSdHKrmQmeSoz47tsOrfvaupyaoBhweRDfS5AM4QQPmwG2KzAl0Z6LKHg8ydmUOlbdfHtm8bUjGqLRX43HtEI3DXZjainCunAuOM1m8LgNSpIQQr2FBaimyMXsjCdJYWhZReLKmDfNPmI7Dcwe)

Friend, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Friend, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=db189ff0c10e49b69f441e3a5dc55612&_e=gk_eXUelJMQL2U16O614ihwznnvaRRE7Edxn8D-VwW89VjMpAbkESjb3SDOg2sOQs6DilveX8u9DL1xpvn1UgzMifxg90N_ppLe-cru-kJFyETEdqiZ28S2grBjQSTbSmG3CCsm5aiGA0HjaGdHyVTklF5uwdeWuQhtBgcPV0LzIFNEfoibg94N4NBcyASbdUYCemCdC7SNiwSx5GmXYvNAgJeb1S-pNxOSnYUhnU4YTeFiE_yke970_sBMJpIz5OSPmrJs8pUTbiQgUY-ZwpqY1sRZtXY6JRi6uLbpm9JZCb3Sf2xsjr-WOLsa_AwQr)_

* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

* It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

* It's NOT a call for __ our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on __ how _all Americans_ can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving _ourselves_.

Folks,

I'm up a creek without a paddle, and my pirogue just sprung a huge leak.

I'm giving it all I got to stand up for you and our Conservative values, but everywhere I turn, there are more and more of them woke loonies.

I was scrolling through my photos last night, and I just had to share this
one, Peter:

[ https://act.hillharper.com/go/790?t=1002&akid=1304%2E62735%2EKvXQu1 ]Hill Harper pictured with his son, Pierce, advocating for United Auto Workers
at a strike last year.

[ https://act.hillharper.com/go/2097?t=1003&akid=1304%2E62735%2EKvXQu1 ]DONATE »

It’s one of my all-time favorites from the campaign trail: my son Pierce,
perched up on my shoulders (one of his favorite places to be), during the
historic United Auto Workers strike last year.

As a single father, my whole world revolves around Pierce. Adopting him is
the single greatest decision I ever made — his laughter is my joy, his
dreams are my aspirations, and his future is my driving motivation. Every
morning I drop him off at school, I’m reminded of the responsibility I
bear as his father to shape a world that nurtures, protects, and empowers
him to be his best self.

Peter, I truly
believe in a better Michigan — and I’m running for U.S. Senate to deliver
it not just for my own son, but your kids, too.

I want them to grow up in a world where healthcare is a fundamental human
right, where workers are treated with dignity, and where the toxic
influence of money in politics is overpowered by the will of the people.
Their collective future hinges on the decisions we make today, and I can
promise you: As Michigan’s next Senator, I’ll make every decision, every
vote, with our kids’ futures in mind. I’ll fight like hell and work with
Democrats, Republicans, Independents — whoever it takes — to deliver
progress on the issues you care about.

But I can’t do it alone.

[ https://act.hillharper.com/go/2097?t=1005&akid=1304%2E62735%2EKvXQu1 ]We have less than 12 days until the primary,
and it’s going to take ALL of us working together to win this election.
So, I have to ask: Will you please chip in $5 today to fuel our
people-powered campaign?

donation will go through immediately:

subject: The most important race of our lives
body:
The stakes for the lives of the unborn couldn’t be any higher.
__
Stop the Biden Administration's radical abortion agenda! | | | | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_s=04c49f3ee43543698e06127c1175a731&_t=q9RZUJbI_x381kvVsGwsgFzJx4e7qqdH0svTVyZS1LTe7gNY9jSLltskHfaYZJk1pZmDE8w1b07vTvJaPn__iavoYJ94TCvGZjR52wDNmYRmbsCUq_NoTnKkGT63CqO8)_

[](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=04c49f3ee43543698e06127c1175a731&_e=SZ6sYfdj98Y9XnwcgWmYo7N6az-DTsNW1Fvj8AUSQZ0t34id6jYdekeg4m2QasgIxcie3-1T6xG-SxXL_rs4DshncSi4oFz30RsJHRFruf0btUdf9rfTgAAGEA7ynQS4KdnLrSsVnTraLFDwbPKdSOVtgC5WqgG98fLCFWMo034XWERXWzWW9mU6epdBCexPWP343jjYTeEkn0MxK8EbjPn84fPtmlmf6kCq_0BuKPrY_luQCf3hSuM---HvoaeksApfWI6OQngsSO-9TRjAjWZEIbu0oGCWqF7cJZ1EvLXHA8ZlkqKDMSSbbQ8FduihhedsuzwraCt3s60ktTzonpX584NyL7rYzCaUtNIlGl5q480a0m7DIioFJx2L4-J8gMBz-L7wDuyPLxarccIOBA%3D%3D)

---
| |
Fellow Americans,

We still have several months before the 2024 election, but the battle lines have been clearly drawn and now we have a critical task to do.

**The stakes for the lives of the unborn couldn 't be any higher.**

The truth is that the best way for me and you to serve women and save babies is for all pro-life supporters to throw our entire weight behind pro-life candidates. Seriously.

And protecting the innocent lives of the unborn doesn't start and end with who occupies the White House in January of next year.

At the end of the day, if Congress isn't full of pro-life lawmakers, then there won't be any legislation to sign into law that will protect women from the dangers of abortion or the innocent lives of millions of babies who will be slaughtered through this deadly industry in the years and decades to come.

**It sounds clich e to say that this election is the most important one of our lives, but it absolutely is true.**

The overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ was an important step in protecting the innocent lives murdered by Big Abortion, but it was just the first step in the process.

Let's be honest... the pro-life movement has lost key battles at the state level to radicals who want abortion to be legal up until the moment of birth.

**The pendulum must swing back the other way.**

The Supreme Court decided to return the decision to the states, but Congress still has the power to write laws that federally mandate strict controls over what kind of laws they can write on this subject.

What does that mean exactly? It means that a minimum of a federal 15-week pain-capable limit is still possible.

The best part? _**About 70% of Americans say that they would support it.**_

We just need to fill Congress with enough pro-life lawmakers to be bold enough to push for it.

That's why I'm writing to you today.

The truth is that there are a lot of pro-life organizations that do fine work in the movement today, but there isn't anyone better positioned than SBA to get this job done.

We are the only pro-life organization that has the infrastructure to actually make a difference in elections this November. On top of that, we have a laser-focused and targeted strategy to get the job done. How?

We have been working tirelessly for more than a year now to:
* Identify strong pro-life champions who will win elections in vulnerable House and Senate seats this Fall by running on platforms to protect the unborn.
* Actively coach and equip those candidates with strong talking points and defensible positions that will persuade voters to vote for them because of the pro-life positions they take.
* Help them to develop strong policy prescriptions that have compassion for women and a desire to offer care options instead of leaving vulnerable mothers to succumb to the abortion industry's lies (which would have them kill their unborn child instead).
* Help them to advocate for stronger protections for pregnancy centers against the onslaught of leftist attacks from Planned Parenthood radicals and fanatics.
* Provide them with world-class scientific research that proves the dangers of poisonous abortion drugs to mothers and their children, and the truth about the existence of human life present in the mother's womb from the moment of conception.

We are all-in on this year's election -- AND -- on protecting the lives of the unborn against the radical left's culture of death once and for all!

**There 's just one problem, Friend...**

To keep this massive war machine in operation, we must hit specific fundraising goals each and every day.

Unfortunately, we have fallen behind the pace that we need to keep everything fully operational and on track to win in November.

**The truth is that I need another 10 donors to make a gift before the end of the day.**

Do you think that you could be one of those 10?

If so, would you take a moment right now to make your donation online at this secure donation form?

[https://secure.sbaprolife.org/election-planning](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=04c49f3ee43543698e06127c1175a731&_e=SZ6sYfdj98Y9XnwcgWmYo7N6az-DTsNW1Fvj8AUSQZ0t34id6jYdekeg4m2QasgIxcie3-1T6xG-SxXL_rs4DshncSi4oFz30RsJHRFruf0btUdf9rfTgAAGEA7ynQS4KdnLrSsVnTraLFDwbPKdSOVtgC5WqgG98fLCFWMo034XWERXWzWW9mU6epdBCexPWP343jjYTeEkn0MxK8EbjPn84fPtmlmf6kCq_0BuKPoHFDTqJa2mD2nrP3_wowHc0iA_c3iB2EByjEDdbklXCdnR6ufAmqzTaH-4DWMvKwSkMH_l90JAdgSVVhS7ZXj4aOavdxeevAKsDj8eL9PRGt9uP6oukcp4zODAEr9fQ9WlT9bNkjBoHVZYhX2_FS--y2w_cJmakQ_t27qkjen9LA%3D%3D)

If you can make a donation today, I'll be sure to keep you updated on the progress being made through the SBA Pro-Life America Field Team, share the latest updates within our fight for life, and let you know of key decisions and actions you can take as a passionate pro-life champion.

Thank you so much for considering this request today.

Your generous support is certain to save many, many unborn lives.

Thank you again and I hope that you have a wonderful rest of your day.

For Life,

Marjorie Dannenfelser
President, SBA Pro-Life America

# _**Your YDA July Newsletter**_
---
#### _A Special Message from YDA President Quentin Wathum-Ocama_
---
Dear Young Democrats,

We are at a pivotal moment in our nation's history. With President Joe Biden announcing his decision to step down from the 2024 presidential race, we have an opportunity for new leadership to carry forward the torch of our progressive values. It is with great enthusiasm and pride that we rally behind Vice President Kamala Harris as our candidate for the presidency.

The last month has been some of the toughest we've seen politically, filled with uncertainty and challenges. But out of these trials, a new wave of excitement and hope has emerged with Vice President Harris's historic candidacy. Her journey is a testament to the resilience, diversity, and strength that define the Democratic spirit. As the first woman, the first Black woman, and the first South Asian American woman to be nominated for the presidency by a major party, Kamala Harris embodies the change we have long aspired to achieve.

This campaign ignites a wave of excitement and hope across our communities. It is a moment to celebrate our progress and to renew our commitment to building a more just and equitable society. With her unwavering dedication to justice, economic fairness, and climate action, Harris represents the bold and compassionate leadership our country needs.

With Harris leading the charge, we have an unprecedented opportunity not just to keep the White House but to win the House, maintain control of the Senate, and elect Democrats up and down the ballot. As Martin Amis once said, "There are moments in history when time accelerates." We are living through such a moment now, and it’s up to us to make the most of it.
**This month’s newsletter might be a bit longer due to the incredible excitement and energy that Young Democrats are bringing to both local and national press. We have so much to share and celebrate — you may need to click "view more" or "view entire message" on your computer or mobile device.**

Let's seize this moment with enthusiasm and purpose. Together, we can make history. Together, we will build a brighter future for all — in the words of the Vice President, "l**et's win this thing** "**.**
In solidarity,

Quentin Wathum-Ocama
_President, Young Democrats of America_

# _**Young Democrats of America Endorse Kamala Harris**_
---
|
---
On Sunday, the Young Democrats of America endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris to be the next President of the United States of America following a unanimous vote by the Executive Board. Vice President Kamala Harris has dedicated her accomplished career to championing the rights of young people and fighting for justice.

As President, Kamala Harris would be the first Black woman and the first person of Indian descent to become leader of the free world. The historic nature of a Harris Presidency presents an opportunity for America to demonstrate to the world, and to ourselves, that we are truly a nation where diversity empowers the very best of us. With President Joe Biden announcing his decision to step down from the 2024 presidential race, we have an opportunity for new leadership to carry forward the torch of our progressive values. It is with great enthusiasm and pride that we rally behind Vice President Kamala Harris as our candidate for the presidency. The last month has been some of the toughest we've seen politically, filled with uncertainty and challenges. But out of these trials, a new wave of excitement and hope has emerged with Vice President Harris's historic candidacy. Her journey is a testament to the resilience, diversity, and strength that define the Democratic spirit. As the first woman, the first Black woman, and the first South Asian American woman to be nominated for the presidency by a major party, Kamala Harris embodies the change we have long aspired to achieve. This campaign ignites a wave of excitement and hope across our communities. It is a moment to celebrate our progress and to renew our commitment to building a more just and equitable society. With her unwavering dedication to justice, economic fairness, and climate action, Harris represents the bold and compassionate leadership our country needs. With Harris leading the charge, we have an unprecedented opportunity not just to keep the White House but to win the House, maintain control of the Senate, and elect Democrats up and down the ballot. As Martin Amis once said, "There are moments in history when time accelerates." We are living through such a moment now, and it’s up to us to make the most of it. This month’s newsletter might be a bit longer due to the incredible excitement and energy that Young Democrats are bringing to both local and national press. We have so much to share and celebrate — you may need to click "view more" or "view entire message" on your computer or mobile device. Let's seize this moment with enthusiasm and purpose. #

Peter -
Things are moving quickly now.
Our inbox is absolutely flooded with emails, and we bet yours is, too. But there’s a reason for that, and it’s an important one.
Folks like Kari Lake and Donald Trump, they go straight to the top for their donations — the richest people they can find. Kari has million dollar fundraisers at Mar-a-Lago, and Trump gets millions a month from shady billionaires from all over the country.
They use the millions they rake in from the most wealthy people in the world to run low down, drag out, dirty campaigns with relentless attack ads across the airwaves. That’s how they’re doing it here in Arizona, and it only gets more intense from here.
But that’s not how we do things. Just about every dollar we raise comes from an email like this one, or a text, or an ad you saw online. We raise our $5 or $10 at a time from people who care about our race, care about Ruben, care about what we’re running for.
It’s real, hardworking people who power this campaign with donations of whatever they can afford. And we’re incredibly grateful for that.

body:
#
Hey Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce — I’m the Democrat and Marine veteran running to replace Republican and January 6th coward Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate.
This is a little different from the emails you usually get from my campaign. But if you have a moment now or later today to even read a little bit of this important message, I’d greatly appreciate it.
**Yesterday, Hawley paid to deliver deceptive and negative attacks against me through texts and emails, just like his insider friends in DC have been doing for months.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61058?refcode=em20240725-7173&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7173%2E614464%2ErGXYdQ)
**[FIGHT BACK NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61058?refcode=em20240725-7173&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7173%2E614464%2ErGXYdQ)**
I want to take a moment to explain why Hawley would do that — and why I’m counting on your first-time support to help our grassroots movement fight back and defeat him this November.
If you can’t read the rest of this message, here’s the top line: **Josh Hawley is running scared of our record-breaking campaign. He will do and say anything to slow down our momentum. And with reproductive rights, worker’s rights, and our economic future all on the line this year, we cannot let him keep lying and cheating to sow even more division.**
U.S. Senate races like ours have never been more important. So if you’ve still got another moment to stick around, please keep reading to learn more about what’s behind these attacks.
**[FIGHT BACK NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61058?refcode=em20240725-7173&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7173%2E614464%2ErGXYdQ)**
Over the last few months, there have been some big moments in our race.
The St. Louis Post-Dispatch and the Kansas City Star both endorsed my campaign, citing my _“coalition of workers and organized labor with veterans and women’s rights supporters,”_ my background being _“raised in a struggling working-class family”_ bankrupted by medical bills, and that my _“extensive legal and military experience far outpaces Hawley’s.”_
**They said that Democrats “have the opportunity for an upset here. They also have an opportunity to seat a senator the state could finally be proud of.”**
The papers back that up with polls showing the race tightening between me and Hawley — which is far closer than the presidential. I’m even beating Hawley already among independent voters!
They’ve mentioned our strong grassroots fundraising too. We have donors in every single one of Missouri’s 114 counties + the City of St. Louis — with 98% of donations $200 or less, and without a cent from corporate PACs.

# Remember to Vote in the Primary!
---
| Ballots for the August 6 Primary Election have been mailed out! **Your ballot must either be postmarked no later than Election Day, August 6, or returned to a ballot drop box by 8 p.m. on Election Day.**
You can find all information about the election [here at the Washington Secretary of State website](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=89003a3fac&e=3ed3552a03).
If you’re not registered to vote or need to update your voter information, [click here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=5736af21d8&e=3ed3552a03).
To access the official VoteWA Voter Registration and Ballot Management Portal, which you can sign into if you are already registered to vote, [click here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=75287c369c&e=3ed3552a03).
You can find all official drop box and voting center locations [here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=a1e73114fd&e=3ed3552a03).
---

|

# Dr Garcia Completes Six-Day Freedom From Fentanyl Walk
---
| | | | | | | | | | | On Sunday, July 21 in Seattle, Raul, his wife Jessica, and many friends & family finished the Freedom From Fentanyl Walk which started on July 16 in central Washington.
It was tough, but for a purpose: to honor the thousands of Washingtonians who’ve died from fentanyl, and to give the people of Washington hope that with the right leaders and policies we can overcome this terrible crisis.
---
| [](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=6b461583d8&e=3ed3552a03)
---
| You can read about the walk and see lots of photos & videos at [fentanylwalk.com](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=71745f1e86&e=3ed3552a03), which redirects you to our website at [garciaforwa.com/fentanyl-walk/](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=5401111346&e=3ed3552a03).
---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=1d295e5c6f&e=3ed3552a03)
---
| | For the final leg of the walk we crossed the I-90 bridge from Mercer Island to Seattle.
We were honored to be joined by 120 people who care deeply about solving the fentanyl crisis with policies that work.
---
| At the end of the walk, we heard from Ginny Burton, a former addict who turned her life around and is now a major force for change, and Laura Lynch, who lost her beautiful 18-year-old daughter Brillion to fentanyl poisoning and is now a strong and courageous advocate.
---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=b9c5fcdbab&e=3ed3552a03)

# Help Dr Garcia Win in November
