## _Make a Contribution Today!_
---
| Your generous financial support helps Raul reach out to voters all across Washington, especially in the voter-rich Puget Sound area — which is crucial for winning statewide election.
[Please make a contribution to support our cause](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=4175f6f059&e=3ed3552a03). If you’ve already donated, thank you so much, and if you’re able, please consider making another donation.
[Whatever you can give — $100, $50, $25, $10 or even $5 — makes a difference](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=63f899df51&e=3ed3552a03).
Raul is so honored by, and grateful for, your support. Together, we send Sen. Maria Cantwell home in November and bring new leadership to Washington state!
---

name: Derek Lyons - RITE
subject: Joe Biden Dropped Out To Save Democrats, Not Democracy: DEREK LYONS OP-ED
body:
The American people are owed an explanation for the Democrat elite’s coup of their democratically elected nominee for president. |
---
| |
---
| |
# **DEREK LYONS OP-ED: **Joe Biden Dropped Out To Save Democrats, Not Democracy

**[IN THE FEDERALIST](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=f1c566fdc4&e=ea91f782ea): The American people are owed an explanation for the Democrat elite’s coup of their democratically elected nominee for president.** In every election this century, Democrats have smeared Republicans as a party built on voter disenfranchisement. When Democrats lose, it is because Republicans have manipulated voter ID rules, registration requirements, or early and mail-in voting periods to suppress votes. Somehow, free IDs, lax registration requirements, weeks upon weeks of early voting, and rules that let able-bodied citizens vote from their couches are voter suppression and the cause of Democrats’ electoral losses. Since Sunday, however, the mask has dropped. We now know which party has no qualms about disenfranchising as many voters as necessary to preserve or gain political power. In orchestrating President Biden’s withdrawal from the 2024 presidential race, Barack Obama, Nancy Pelosi, Hakeem Jeffries, and the rest of the Democrat elite disenfranchised millions of voters across the country. Their calculations and machinations had the same effect as if they had taken every single ballot cast over the past six months and tossed them into the yawning depths of the Grand Canyon. In place of the Democrat voters’ choice of Biden, the country will be offered Kamala Harris — a woman who has the endorsement of exactly zero voters to become president in 2024 and could not even finish within the top [seven](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=3587675a3a&e=ea91f782ea) of the Democrat field in 2020. Perhaps most shocking is how casual and callous leading Democrats have been in their voter suppression efforts. Biden announced that his supporters’ ballots would be disregarded in a post on X — the equivalent of ending a marriage through a text message. He did not explain himself. He did not even offer a photo of him signing the letter that was posted to X. In the moments that followed, leading Democrats did not decry this betrayal of voters nor express an ounce of sympathy for the fate of their ballots. Rather, within minutes, they showered Biden’s ready-made successor with unreserved endorsements and lavish praise. **Read the entire op-ed in The Federalist by clicking[here](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=998bba108e&e=ea91f782ea).**

The CPP creates a large fund that goes directly to environmental justice (EJ) communities most impacted by the climate crisis. It will also set enforceable targets for oil and gas companies to reduce their climate pollution by 2050, but big polluters are fighting tooth and nail to derail the program. [**Will you attend our virtual webinar on Tuesday, July 30 at 5:30 p.m. to learn more about the CPP and how you can help us protect it?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89550220/487655004/-1995800621?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQyM2VlZDU4LWE3NGEtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=dYAZI-mRpM51L7DrYsOf-nE3YRQgyGukhkcQADFcFDk=&emci=2e8b617c-4149-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=d23eed58-a74a-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) **WHEN: Tuesday, July 30th at 5:30 - 6:30 PM
WHERE: via Zoom | Spanish interpretation available** [**Sign up here!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89550224/487655035/-1995800621?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQyM2VlZDU4LWE3NGEtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=dYAZI-mRpM51L7DrYsOf-nE3YRQgyGukhkcQADFcFDk=&emci=2e8b617c-4149-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=d23eed58-a74a-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) This powerful program can represent a meaningful win for EJ communities, especially Black, Indigenous, people of color, low-income families, folks with disabilities, seniors, children, and rural and coastal communities who experience climate change first and worst. Right now, part of the program that empowers and invests in us is under attack. Attend this free webinar to learn more about CPP’s investments in our communities, examples of projects it can be used for, and what YOU can do to make a difference. The Oregon Climate Protection Program is an easy way to make a positive impact and address the root cause of climate change. We want to hear your voice. Spanish interpretation will be available. [**Peter, will you help us restore the Climate Protection Program? **](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89550229/487655041/-1995800621?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQyM2VlZDU4LWE3NGEtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=dYAZI-mRpM51L7DrYsOf-nE3YRQgyGukhkcQADFcFDk=&emci=2e8b617c-4149-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=d23eed58-a74a-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) We can't wait for you to join the fight! I’ll get straight to the point, team:
**Young voters are the key to preventing a MAGA takeover at the highest level of government.**
If you haven’t already heard, Project 2025 is an _extreme_ far-right playbook designed to upend our democracy, dismantle our rights, and give Donald Trump dictatorial power from day one of a potential second term.
If we don’t step up now and get young voters nationwide ready to vote in November, we can fully expect Project 2025 to take effect.
That means dissolving the Department of Education, a nationwide abortion ban, a complete overhaul of the Department of Justice, and much, _much_ more.
With so much at risk, **it’s more important than ever that we turn out young voters to defend our rights and democracy at the ballot box — especially in battleground states like North Carolina and Pennsylvania.**
Here at NextGen PAC, we’re doing everything in our power to champion the progressive youth agenda at the ballot box. This youth-powered movement needs all the resources it can get to defend our democracy and defeat Trump and Project 2025.
[But we can’t do it without you. name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: It’s Time to Take Back the House!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
Our team is working to win our #TX07 race and win back the House majority so we can get back to getting things done. Good things. Things Americans want done.
This 2024 election cycle, I am serving as House Democrats’ National Battleground Finance Vice Chair. What does that mean? It means I am tasked with helping make sure our members facing the toughest re-election races this year (who we call Frontliners) have the resources they need to win and that candidates taking on Republican incumbents (who we call Red-to-Blue) have them, too.
I know a thing or two about this, and so do you. In 2018, I was a Red-to-Blue candidate, and together we won this seat for Democrats for the first time in more than 50 years. In 2020, I was a Frontliner, fighting to hold on to this seat against an onslaught of unfounded attacks and negative ads. You know what happened. Now, I am focused on helping members in races that are even more expensive than the ones we had in 2018 and 2020 and in the environment of this presidential election year, which is as tough as any we have seen.
In 2018, when we won this race, some pretty amazing people won races all across the country—from California to Maine and all in between—to help Democrats take back the House. We picked up 40 seats that year. Those candidates became colleagues. We’ve been through a lot together since we were sworn in in January 2019. And we have a record of meaningful accomplishments to be proud of. But we have a lot of work left to do. And it will only happen if we all come back to do the work together.
So, today, I want to make sure you know about my friends from the Class of 2018 who are facing some of the toughest races in the country and to ask you to support them: Angie Craig (MN-02), Sharice Davids (KS-03), Jared Golden (ME-02), Jahana Hayes (CT-05), Josh Harder (CA-09), Steven Horsford (NV-04), Susie Lee (NV-03), Mike Levin (CA-49), Chris Pappas (NH-01), Kim Schrier (WA-08), and Susan Wild (PA-07). I’ve included a link here where you can split a contribution among these candidates however you like. Using this link, they will know that #TeamLizzie has been there and will be there for them this critical election year. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240725split_frontliners?refcode=lpfe240725split_frontliners]
I don’t have to tell you how important this year’s election is. Or the importance of winning back the House of Representatives. You’ve been there, and you’ve seen it. I can tell you that one of the best investments you can make to win back the House and put our country on a better path is in these exceptional members of Congress.
We need to keep all 11 of these leaders in the Congress. You can click here to split a contribution between Angie, Sharice, Jared, Jahana, Josh, Steven, Susie, Mike, Chris, Kim, and Susan. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240725split_frontliners?refcode=lpfe240725split_frontliners]

A movement made up of regular folks like you, who put in whatever time, energy, and yes, donations that they can.

name: Mesoscale.News with Rebekah Jones
subject: Birthday wishes!
body:
On my 35th birthday, I am grateful to all of you for your enduring support and love!

| |
---|---|---
|
# Birthday wishes!
| | Jul 25
---|---
On my 35th birthday, I am grateful to all of you for your enduring support and love!
The last several years have been both rewarding and difficult.
[Click to send Rebekah a birthday gift!](https://substack.com/redirect/7909a91c-2ef1-4a32-bf37-91f8386f6eaa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
To quote the top-secret prologue writer for my upcoming memoir, "Rebekah's retelling of her story is _**harrowing, heartbreaking and at times hilarious.**_ "
Harrowing, heartbreaking and hilarious are my middle names.
I've covered lots of the [harrowing and heartbreaking parts here](https://substack.com/redirect/7d0e4c42-5fe6-4b3d-b20a-a1f65c10ef89?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
So here's a recap of some of the _happy_ times in the past few years:
**At about 31 years old:**
I was named one of Fortune's 40 under 40 in Healthcare, Forbes' first-ever Technology Person of the Year, winner of the Samuel Lawrence Prize, Whistleblower of the Year and much more!
**At 32-33 years old:**
I ran for Congress, became a professional basketball player for a day, was nominated for the John Maddox Prize awarded by _Nature_ , gave the keynote address to the largest academic gathering in my field, and lived my absolute best life.
**At 34 years old:**
I received the Martha Mitchell Pillar Award for my whistleblowing efforts -- the highest honor given by the nation's largest whistleblowing community. I fulfilled my life's dream of going to Greece, and began collaborating on a global plan to protect whistleblowers.
**At 35 years old:**
I'm launching a series this fall ([exclusively on substack](https://substack.com/redirect/96de2023-b3a2-4741-97dd-2ceab5227639?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) I've been working on for more than decade, I'll be speaking at the capitol again for National Whistleblower Day (next week), I'll be speaking at this year's annual AGU conference, my lawsuit against the state of Florida is scheduled for next Spring, the documentary about my life will be released, and I will complete my memoir (promise)!
Mesoscale.News with Rebekah Jones is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9yZWJla2Foam9uZXMuc3Vic3RhY2suY29tL2FjY291bnQiLCJwIjoxNDcwMDMxODgsInMiOjI4MzQ0OSwiZiI6ZmFsc2UsInUiOjkwNTAxMTkyLCJpYXQiOjE3MjE5Mjg3NjYsImV4cCI6MTcyNDUyMDc2NiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTAiLCJzdWIiOiJsaW5rLXJlZGlyZWN0In0.ZaVnfgDGh4vVfv3PRRXdkEQMPwMm26qnjMJxKoU8K9I?)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c7e7960a-e0a5-40b9-b3e0-3f28c8505024?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Thirty five and still serving! Cheers to the next 35!

**Less than 24 hours later, our former president was shot during a rally, and a great American dad in the audience lost his life shielding his family from harm.**

Kennedy has consistently been ahead of the curve on issues such as mandates, lockdowns, corporate capture, and the erosion of our Constitutional freedoms. Now, he warns us of the peril of our internal division and offers **#AmericaStrong** as a path to healing.
“We’ve given the Democrats a chance to fix this country. We’ve given Republicans a chance,” Kennedy said. “What has not had a chance is a unity government, headed by an independent President beholden to no party, free from corporate influence, owing no favors to the Washington establishment, and ready to recruit the best ideas from both parties and from all those who have been left out.”
The America Strong platform will:
* Appoint a cabinet comprising members of the Democratic and Republican parties, as well as Libertarians and people from outside any party.
* Convene a cross-partisan advisory committee to propose and select Supreme Court judges.
* Carefully examine whether any prosecutions of public and private officials were politically motivated and extend pardons to any people who have been politically persecuted.
* Consider pardoning any past president and members of their families if charges against them next year were politically motivated.
* Forbid the weaponization of the Justice Department, the IRS, or any other government agency to surveil or undermine political opponents or their supporters.
* Give the American people a direct voice in guiding legislation and scrutinizing the budget through direct democracy initiatives.

[Join the America Strong Movement](https://www.kennedy24.com/america-strong?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_americastrong_7_25_24_all_1&n=4#join)
Kennedy first shared his America Strong platform at FreedomFest Vegas, one day before the attempted assassination of President Trump. During his keynote, he described a nation swiftly approaching a state of crisis—a crisis of trust in government, as well as a crisis of national division.
**#AmericaStrong** is the solution we need to bridge our divides and build a prosperous future for all Americans.
[Let's come together to support this vital initiative.](https://www.kennedy24.com/america-strong?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_americastrong_7_25_24_all_1&n=5#join)

Peter, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Peter, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=f37a1a5428a54ee693b4fc04a77f7354&_e=Q00vARUymkPsXcpFFMZ0xyhJQpQRi2OP-wZrFAzUIWuHYzXeD2qd0PTx-PjIOdKordLQMsmJXHcUpL_QrY3nv4sMUVR0P7C8wUveHbzXkB0Ltahzj-MNirDh2jdM2JFsNgYcAz47ODmspY6bWwyO1jlGDGTKgTACnvAll5Wuu4xNm5TpX1EvNA_AXR0p34-u-56Rz6tiyasWvW-biQS94qcENPjkwhWuaE0acZV26pK1uWINi-Gzbtn-sOHed-QWkE6OMvRvOyMbMzuesqeJX3ph1VuYf7OkMEELh6Rw_WeppanR9n5LQeJeQYXm9KWu)_

* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

* It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

|
---
Friend,

Our only goal for the next 4 months is to do whatever is needed to defeat Donald Trump in November—**and we just made our biggest move yet**.
We just put up **76 billboards** across the Blue Wall states of Michigan, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin, featuring local former Trump voters who are going to vote for Vice President Kamala Harris.
---
[ ](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/VXj4Tt5jgQ1wVb-ZVQ2Z8T6NW1f4B6k5hYSxHN20xtvT3m2ndW7lCdLW6lZ3pvW7lcF-23q2hJ9W6mnvq170kMm0W2fzqR-7dFnHgW8xBfkX7jh1JsW38zLnq1l38cPW314B6G3slsjVW9fmtGQ3GKmcpW5Rs-yk6BHgmkN6LQkHHVlq6YV5M-ZF3m4NL4W8tLmFk3jwrhpW9h8w1-2qgLxhW5CJRgt4wlm2CW3xb7VL7gWtLrW4Nvffh5TgDf6W21F6GR8d7ZBkW1HVCfs6_WRndW1VffqH1_hg1sVM7jWl51SlG-W7SD7r54ygBmtW7NwBt15c7D6yVt8kjN7lP8slW4RB3Js2lkC-dW2MxsvB5_nnh1f2TqTz404)
---
This is our first major campaign since Biden dropped out, and we are laser focused on the voters who will decide this election. With such momentum moving against Trump, now is the time to strike. **And that’s exactly what we’re doing.**

| | Check it out...

_Idaho is too smart for ranked choice voting..._

_Consider this cautionary tale from Alaska_:

In the special election for Alaska's House seat in 2022, the state used ranked-choice voting for the first time. Sarah Palin, a Republican, was one of the candidates running.

Despite a majority of voters choosing a Republican candidate as their first choice, the ranked-choice system led to a different outcome.

**__In the initial count, Republican candidates Sarah Palin and Nick Begich received more combined votes than Democratic candidate Mary Peltola_._**

However, since no candidate received more than 50% of the vote in the first round, the ranked-choice process came into play. In the final round, when Begich was eliminated, his votes were redistributed based on the second choices indicated by his voters.

Bottom line?

Many of Begich's voters did not choose Palin as their second choice.

As a result, Mary Peltola "won" the election after receiving enough of the redistributed votes to surpass 50%.

This showed that even though a majority of Alaskans initially voted for a Republican candidate, the ranked-choice voting system **_allowed a Democrat candidate with second-choice votes to “win.”_**

You can see why this is BAD, right?

**[Our Attorney General sure can](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=f39f18473e&e=dea908e0fe "see the latest")...**

Cheers,

Team,

---

| | Hi, Peter. I know a thing or two about what it takes to win an at-large congressional seat far from the D.C. swamp.
We brought _**integrity**_ back to Wyoming in 2022, and now it's your turn to help make history in Alaska for my friend and Alaska's lieutenant governor, Nancy Dahlstrom.

Hard working Alaskans deserve a Congresswoman who will actually get things done and not play political theatre. I know a lot about that too. **_[**_Will you step forward with a contribution of just $5 or maybe more to make it happen?_**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=a8e41c2a970b44d0a291e2cbf8512a7f&_m=bf2a08acf1554eec80fdcd60c14e59ac&_e=8h4O48gapy00omnUbgikFy-qsBivj7fEwiMBkOR7it5bpQw7BMhe2rdVtwgcR414rm-YM4l8ciUA86UMHJAIh8ARp4G7Vfk9Tmwwpk16Rpi2z6g4IzzIsjIk1QLp0tj0Y-nxm3_86ua0cGa4rDp-ydU05yl2PuqdS4gqV3x8ZnkgEPnhpvU8l-25n_Ke_5pAdT38nYoVT6z060naqoypxWb0wPggqJ7OjM52U3g0zqcCa3iCe9JDKAI_MZDVN0TXbnXS7QAZbLtqYxUQ9GrnFtTEKOjH_CPOph-p5pdobNNbXuoxN7A9nNUAmHg06dqM)_**

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=a8e41c2a970b44d0a291e2cbf8512a7f&_m=bf2a08acf1554eec80fdcd60c14e59ac&_e=8h4O48gapy00omnUbgikFy-qsBivj7fEwiMBkOR7it5bpQw7BMhe2rdVtwgcR414rm-YM4l8ciUA86UMHJAIh8ARp4G7Vfk9Tmwwpk16Rpi2z6g4IzzIsjIk1QLp0tj0Y-nxm3_86ua0cGa4rDp-yaAmlfhv4ggR-bcOOVL1LHX2Ra7E-aYziSyvRQm3bpj32gFq4-IYrKlIKz2bv7oAjFTmKJKbmyi5P0uop_tpeP2j2_DBdihv5EEE0XqDMgmgedp62rRIRS6vk081m-l4_uvn0BdA8tM8t_wYkcczTTiIu6-02s6ajyT3PitV_2dx)

Wyoming and Alaska both have statewide Congressional seats, and take it from a ranch girl, they are a different kind of animal. It takes a special kind of in-touch representative like Nancy to truly understand the variety of needs, perspectives, dreams and concerns of people from the city to the countryside and everywhere in between. The Kansas City Star has officially endorsed Matt Kleinmann for Congress! [https://www.kansascity.com/opinion/editorials/article290378859.html]

They don’t support him now, and if we're being honest, they didn’t really support him in 2018, when he only won by **0.12% of the vote** — _especially considering he had to spend $64 MILLION to buy this seat in the first place._
**So now that he’s moving in complete lockstep with Donald Trump and J.D. Vance** — from supporting their baseless voter fraud claims to promoting their dangerous far-right agenda at the Republican National Convention — **Floridians have had enough of Rick Scott.**

Mia

freedomva.org [freedomva.org]
Virginia has the opportunity to opt into Direct File, a free tax filing tool from the IRS.
As an organization, we are committed to lowering the cost of living. Taxes and the tax filing process can be extremely expensive. Often, companies will advertise “free tax filing” and then require a purchase to use the tool to its full potential. This leads to complications when filing taxes.
Direct File would provide an entirely free tax filing experience. The IRS is inviting states to partner by July 31st to provide residents with access to the service in 2025. For more information you can read this letter from some of Virginia’s Congressional members below:
Click here for more information [https://beyer.house.gov/uploadedfiles/va_free_file_letter_7.16.24.pdf]

You can vote for November's elections NOW! Vote at your Registrar's office during business hours. Saturday early voting is available October 28th and November 4th. Learn More [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
Find your local Registrar's office here: https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/VWCC.jpeg] 15 years of the Community College Access Program at VWCC
Learn More [https://www.wdbj7.com/2023/09/26/virginia-western-celebrates-15th-anniversary-ccap-program/] CCAP is a successful public/private partnership that pays the cost of tuition for three years at Virginia Western Community College if a qualified student does not have sufficient financial aid to pay tuition costs.
This program has helped over 4,200 students achieve higher education!
CANDIDATE SPOTLIGHT
https://karenforvirginia.com/ [https://karenforvirginia.com/] Karen Jenkins for HB-89
Donate Here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/karenforvirginia] Karen Jenkins is a life-long resident of the City of Suffolk. Throughout her lifetime she has passionately advocated for others and currently serves on the Suffolk School Board with a proven track record and history of accomplishments. She is running for the House of Delegates for the 89th District to continue delivering results for the people of Virginia.
She is a champion for education, public safety and mental health. As your next Delegate for the 89th District, she will continue to fight and vote for meaningful policies and legislation to support the needs of the district. At the state level, she will be positioned to write and sponsor bills and laws to benefit the schools and communities in the 89th District and throughout the commonwealth.

Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game - Oct. 1 Henrietta Lacks Statue Unveiling - Oct. 4
Join us for the 6th Annual Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game, being held at the Home of the Salem Red Sox - Carilion Clinic Field. A dignified sculpture will commemorate the ongoing and long unrecognized contributions of Roanoke native Henrietta Lacks, who unknowingly provided the world with the HeLa cell, fueling decades of life-saving and life changing research.
Physicians, nurses and administrators will suit up for each hospital during the nine-inning contest. Proceeds will benefit the American Heart Association. Unveiling is October 4th at 11 am at Henrietta Lacks Plaza.
Admission is $5 at the gate, kids under 10 free. Gates open at 1pm and the game starts at 2pm. 410 3rd St SW, Roanoke, VA 24011

Imagine a country that decides for women how they are allowed to dress, and punishes those women who refuse with fines, bans on education, and denial of basic access to even play sports. I'm talking of course, about France.
As world class athletes gear up this week for the 2024 Paris Olympics, one group of women is banned from competing--[Muslim Olympians who wear the hijab](https://substack.com/redirect/08a4116e-f64b-42db-9213-20e468530978?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). But this ban goes far beyond fascist opposition against Muslim women, and reveals the ugly underbelly of French hatred towards women and girls in general. The receipts I present below paint a daunting picture of the work needed for meaningful reform.
**Let 's Address This.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bdb11dd6-7d35-45c5-a6ab-4df303a43bdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Illustrated by Zeinab al-Hajj; Mayadeen English
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=146737794&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ2NzM3Nzk0LCJpYXQiOjE3MjE5MzQ5NzMsImV4cCI6MTcyNDUyNjk3MywiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.IF4w17Zm-8X5_xo06295_V6g1hnFH8qbeEZl3IAWOjk)
[The IOC](https://substack.com/redirect/0aad3b09-53f5-44eb-86d2-ed7fa9a09511?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the [World Economic Forum](https://substack.com/redirect/95629b33-cdde-4872-8fbf-abcdf1c80faf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and France itself are touting the 2024 Paris Olympic Games as the "Gender Equal Olympics" because women will represent 50% of participants. Yet, their declarations come with a glaring asterisk. You see, Muslim women who wear the hijab are deemed incompatible with French secular values and are therefore excluded from competition. France's version of women's empowerment is not about ensuring women can dress as they choose, but about dictating how women should dress according to how the French government chooses.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/05b6ed44-b38e-4147-b7fb-aebb6495dbe0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Consider, Diaba Konaté, named NCAA college basketball [Big West conference's](https://substack.com/redirect/e51ccd68-0d6a-4007-9967-b99e58f08d65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) best defensive player of the year and is a breakout star. But because she wears the hijab, France has banned her from Olympic competition. This exclusion extends beyond Muslim women and reveals the broader issue of misogyny within French society.
Konaté is not alone. France insists on infusing itself in every aspect of women's lives, particularly those of Muslim women who choose to wear the hijab. This July [France banned a soccer player from wearing her hijab on the field](https://substack.com/redirect/d6e2983a-140d-45e6-9ceb-091f26b956c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). France additionally [banned individual girls from choose to wear the abaya in a state run school](https://substack.com/redirect/3f3a2198-72ad-41df-836b-f873b99fc9c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), stating that attire should stay in the mosque (while also shutting down dozens of mosques). In swimming pools, France [fined a woman $575 for swimming in a burkini, despite her having rented the pool](https://substack.com/redirect/c5b5c0e0-c011-4e68-a7fd-99a56f5a9251?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for private use. The pool had to be "cleaned" afterward--an action reminiscent of how white supremacists "cleaned" pools in the 1950s after Black people swam in them. And even when hypocrisy slaps France in the face, they pretend to see nothing. Who can forget that [France mandated masks as part of its COVID19 protocols, yet maintained its ban on burqas](https://substack.com/redirect/99666e41-b93f-4750-9183-24f1f1842d39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And not content with oppressing women within its own borders, France [forced cancellation of a European campaign that celebrates Muslim women who choose to wear the hijab](https://substack.com/redirect/feceec93-157c-4686-b80a-405cd5f94b5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This isn't just policy; it's exported extremism and racism in action. And yes, it gets still worse in France for women and girls.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..4YD_WPYTmS2Sqk4D6_IilSCIo-TdkoMw91QCgypsCRU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146737794)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ff804f33-df1b-49a5-a1ed-5a4535a431b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
While banning the hijab, claiming it was "oppressive to women," French courts ruled that [a group of firefighters who repeatedly raped a 13-year-old girl cannot be charged with rape](https://substack.com/redirect/ddfd04ae-147b-4d4a-ae01-a99ea4aa0ae2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--arguing a 13-year-old somehow gave consent. After mass outrage, France finally passed age of consent laws, [arriving at 15, not 18](https://substack.com/redirect/c66e313e-46fd-4d03-b699-7b1c0cad4939?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Therefore, to draw a fine point on the absurdity here, the legal age of sexual consent in France is 15, but the legal age for dressing oneself in France is 18. And yes it gets still worse. France's culture of misogyny and child abuse extend beyond racism against Muslims. The country has a significant problem with sexual abuse and pedophilia, sanctioned by the church and silently approved by politicians.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d2c5fed7-2f21-47e1-87d8-19d55d08b967?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
For example, a shocking recent report documents that over [330,000 children have been sexually abused by French clergy and pedophiles in France's churches since 1950](https://substack.com/redirect/83f5f451-b6c3-4c84-aa24-55efd8cd55a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Yet, France has not shut down one church, nor has a single clergy person faced prosecution for these horrific crimes. Meanwhile, [France has recently shut down 30 mosques](https://substack.com/redirect/4be2679f-91ee-4a16-8c01-470ea45d9359?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with little explanation, and banned the hijab in schools and workplaces, all in the name of "secular values." This selective enforcement reveals a troubling double standard. To be sure, this is not an attack on Christianity or Christians, but a condemnation of the French government's hypocrisy and failure to protect children while demonizing an already marginalized Muslim minority. Perhaps instead of dictating women's attire, French courts should focus on holding abusers accountable?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c9f1004d-6406-4bec-a312-58010d4b7932?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Even as adults, French women are not free from sexual harassment and abuse. In a thorough survey, [a horrifying 100% of Parisian women reported suffering sexual harassment from French men](https://substack.com/redirect/53ed77b6-8292-4e07-a81d-99cdfe75a59d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). But maybe instead of simply complaining about this oppression, French Muslim women should get engaged in civil service, get elected, and help change these oppressive laws, right? That sounds great in theory, until you see just how embedded this French fascism has become. Recently, [French President Macron's ruling party dropped candidate Sara Zemmahi because](https://substack.com/redirect/dad4edf5-4193-4d41-bedf-a9eb8aa0f8d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) "her hijab violates secularism." Zemmahi did everything right, activated her supporters, got on the ballot, and ran on a platform of change and inclusion--and the so-called left in France shut her down. This is both absurd and bigoted. A secular government does not mean the elimination of faith--it means equal justice for all, regardless of faith or no faith.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..4YD_WPYTmS2Sqk4D6_IilSCIo-TdkoMw91QCgypsCRU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146737794)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9c30d186-cca6-41ca-98c6-dd6019020223?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Sara Zemmahi, wearing a hijab, holds her campaign flyer with the slogan 'Different, but united, in Montpellier, France, Credit: REUTERS/Yiming Woo
Finally, consider this irony: France has banned Muslim women from wearing the hijab and burqa because such attire is seen as antithetical to liberty. Yet, it was France who gifted to the United States the Statue of Liberty--a statue of a woman donning a burqa and hijab, [designed after an Egyptian Muslim woman](https://substack.com/redirect/0980efaa-0b51-4619-aeed-490fb0a19d0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). France's double standards and hypocrisy are glaring and undeniable.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5795def0-5fcb-43ec-80d8-fdbd1c9ed4a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Here's the bottom line. Women should not have to remove their hijab to exist freely in France, just as they should not have to wear a hijab to exist freely in Iran. Women deserve freedom of bodily autonomy, period. Hardline men need to check themselves instead. Indeed, the real problem is not women or the hijab, but rather the insecure men who feel the need to exert control over women through oppressive policies.
As the world watches the 2024 Summer Olympics, it is crucial to recognize and call out this hypocrisy and misogyny in France's policies. Only by addressing these injustices can we hope to rectify them. If France is serious about reform, it must protect true freedom of religion for all residents, including Muslim women, and ensure women in France have complete rights and bodily autonomy. Such an act would make the 2024 Paris Olympics _actually_ worthy of the title, "Gender Equal Olympics."

Vance is going to spend a ton of time in Pennsylvania because it is the tipping point for both the Senate and the White House this November. If we take our eyes off the target for even one second, only trouble will come. Project 2025 and the threat it poses is something we need to be worried about. JD Vance supports this extreme agenda to severely limit our rights, and we have to stop him from getting the power to enact it. We’re fighting night and day for women’s rights, workers’ rights, and the right to vote in Pennsylvania, and we need you to join us. # Outrage at Flag Burning at Union Station
### This is a disgrace that this allowed to happen!!
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
| Jul 25
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
I am writing to express my profound outrage and deep disappointment at the disgraceful incident of flag burning at Union Station. It is absolutely unacceptable that such a heinous act is taking place in our nation's capital, Washington D.C.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/841ef01a-5854-44e3-8250-b9b45bf8b590?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Those responsible for this despicable act of disrespect towards our flag should be held accountable and face the full extent of the law. It is imperative that these individuals be sent back to where they came from and that justice be served swiftly and firmly. This kind of behavior is not only a blatant disregard for our country's symbols but also an affront to the values we hold dear as a nation.
We must stand united against such acts of vandalism and ensure that those who engage in them are appropriately punished. This kind of lawlessness cannot and will not be tolerated. This is another reason come November we must elect Donald Trump as the 47th President of this great Nation!!

He has presided over historically significant legislative achievements.

### Democrats are gleefully sweeping aside a decade of research. Maybe that's a good thing?
| | [Ryan Grim](https://substack.com/@ryangrim)
---
| Jul 25
---
---
| | | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1711&post_id=147011317&utm_source=substack&isFreemail=true&submitLike=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ3MDExMzE3LCJyZWFjdGlvbiI6IuKdpCIsImlhdCI6MTcyMTkzODE4MywiZXhwIjoxNzI0NTMwMTgzLCJpc3MiOiJwdWItMTcxMSIsInN1YiI6InJlYWN0aW9uIn0.h2bPBaXuMR_ZpDCZU-7knetreId3rp-UHyoe7QRULTE&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-reaction&r=1hvr60)

Moments after Joe Biden dropped out and Kamala Harris jumped in to replace him, the group EMILY's List, which has made boosting Harris a top priority, was out with a strong message of support: "We're We're #allinforKamala, are you?" [they tweeted,](https://substack.com/redirect/819232da-9fd2-4fc8-a7a6-d7610e72693b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with a graphic underneath reading, "I'm all in for Kamala." It was a bit jarring to see, because I was aware that EMILY's List and others have done loads of research showing that referring to a woman candidate by her first name only hurts them with the public. Yet they and the campaign are both doing it heavily. I talked about this odd phenomenon with my friend and old [HuffPost colleague Laura Bassett](https://substack.com/redirect/951ad3c5-fd91-4f56-83ff-4335a501a79b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and she put together this piece on the phenomenon, which I'm publishing below.
If you don't already read her Substack,[ Nightcap](https://substack.com/redirect/819232da-9fd2-4fc8-a7a6-d7610e72693b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), it's definitely worth checking out.
And you've probably heard by now, but Jeremy Scahill and I are in the third week of the launch of [our new outlet Drop Site News](https://substack.com/redirect/0f745d79-4671-425d-abee-393a0cf64a18?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and it's going terrifically. If you're not subscribed, [please do so here.](https://substack.com/redirect/0f745d79-4671-425d-abee-393a0cf64a18?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) The journalism is free, though we rely on paid subscriptions to keep it going.
### What's in a name? Is Kamala or Harris taking on Trump?
#### By [Laura Bassett](https://substack.com/redirect/951ad3c5-fd91-4f56-83ff-4335a501a79b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), with a little reporting by Ryan Grim
Just hours after Joe Biden dropped out of the race on Sunday, his rapid response page on Twitter had transitioned from @BidenHQ to [@KamalaHQ](https://substack.com/redirect/67f1539c-6a31-47e1-835f-84598d5c0d1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and fully rebranded as a ["brat summer"](https://substack.com/redirect/2fb7ec5d-8f14-432c-8a54-350486ccc9ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)-themed page for the Kamala Harris presidential campaign. "Welcome to Kamala HQ," tweeted the account, which displays just her first name in the banner and thumbnail photos. Her first ad, [released today](https://substack.com/redirect/dff82a7d-c28b-4a8b-bb9a-128427b80f8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), features crowds chanting, "Kamala," waving one-word campaign signs with her name.
In Washington, operatives who've spent years in the gender trenches have done a double take this week, fully aware that over the past decade, private research done by the feminist group EMILY's List has shown a distinct pattern when it came to female candidates: Voters react much more favorably to women running for office when their last name is used rather than their first name. EMILY's List has arguably invested more heavily in Harris than any candidate since Hillary Clinton, yet even they leaned into using [her first name only](https://substack.com/redirect/819232da-9fd2-4fc8-a7a6-d7610e72693b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) out of the gate. What gives?
We do tend to call male presidential candidates--Obama, Bush, Trump, Biden--by their last names, and women--Hillary, Kamala, Tulsi--by their first. It could be just a matter of practicality: Hillary needed to be distinguished from the other President Clinton, and Kamala is a more distinctive name than Harris, whereas Trump and Biden are more unique names than Donald and Joe. But according to research EMILY's List has been conducting internally for the past decade or so, the habit has negative political consequences for the women. (Meanwhile, #NotAllMen have eschewed the first-name familiarity with voters. And while it's gone well for some--Mayor Pete has become[ Secretary Pete ](https://substack.com/redirect/8556d95e-d6a0-41b5-91bf-734a0f4adfeb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)and, he no doubt hopes, one day will answer to President Pete--there are also some cautionary tales: Jeb!)
A veteran staffer at the feminist PAC, which was founded in 1985 to elect pro-choice Democratic women to state and national offices, told me they've been doing A/B testing on the use of a candidate's first name vs. her last or full name, and the findings consistently show that voters are more likely to view women candidates favorably in the latter case. This, of course, points to some internalized sexism, as a woman's first name is the only one that can be easily identified as feminine. A separate source who has been briefed on the research said that a more in-depth look is underway to test the strength of what they've found.
And the research tracks with earlier studies showing that men across professional domains, including science and literature, are twice more likely than the women in their fields to be called by their surnames. Those professionals described only by their surname, in turn, are considered to be "more eminent and 14% more deserving of a career award," according to [a 2018 Cornell study](https://substack.com/redirect/cf64a65a-eedb-4279-8bb7-772f70104b6e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
EMILY's List has never made this research public, as it only consists of split-testing on various polls, as opposed to a comprehensive report--and even they don't always abide by their own findings. Shortly after Biden stepped aside, the group's digital team [tweeted a graphic](https://substack.com/redirect/91cdfdb4-c8ce-4684-908c-204bc16f9ac3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of Harris' first name only with the text, "We're #allinforKamala, are you?" Asked about the use of the first name only in the graphic, running contrary to the research, a spokesperson thanked me for flagging it and sent an amended graphic including her last name that the group plans to use going forward.
Yet the momentum of "Kamala" seems unstoppable--a stack of internal research is clearly no match for it. "Harris" just can't keep up. Liberal Washington Post columnist Jennifer Rubin, citing similar [research](https://substack.com/redirect/e293a53a-a0e6-4854-89c3-d33692cf7416?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) research on first names, chided her followers about using Harris's first name on Twitter, only to [get Community Noted](https://substack.com/redirect/7b508730-35b9-40a7-ba07-9e14ac0e8539?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): "Jennifer Rubin referred to Kamala Harris as 'Kamala' multiple times two days ago," observed the community.
Now that Harris is poised to replace Biden, Trump and the GOP are struggling to attack her in any substantive way and are already resorting to every sexist trope in the book. Conservative darlings Matt Walsh and Laura Loomer essentially [called Harris a whore](https://substack.com/redirect/3cd93bfd-fb47-423e-a550-03f449f0000d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who slept her way into politics, and even Megyn Kelly [doubled down](https://substack.com/redirect/85a80cc8-f710-4edc-8221-6f6208600c41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the accusation. Trump, who has bragged about overturning _Roe v. Wade_ and been found civilly liable for sexual assault, walked into the Republican National Convention to a rendition of "It's a Man's Man's Man's World." He chose J.D. Vance as his running mate, who's called women without children--including Harris--["miserable cat ladies"](https://substack.com/redirect/ef1810f4-31b3-4b3a-ad56-3adf6bf08362?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and opposes universal childcare and no-fault divorce, even for domestic abuse victims. Christian Nationalist Lance Wallnau said Harris has the ["spirit of a jezebel](https://substack.com/redirect/7818ce0f-5a18-4c91-b113-d897a9b4288f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," a Biblical term for a wicked, untrustworthy, manipulative woman. Perhaps the use of the first name suggests Democrats intuitively believe they may finally be in a gendered fight, post-Roe, they can actually win.
Subscribe to Laura Bassett's [Substack Nightcap here](https://substack.com/redirect/951ad3c5-fd91-4f56-83ff-4335a501a79b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and check out [Drop Site here](https://substack.com/redirect/0f745d79-4671-425d-abee-393a0cf64a18?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
You're currently a free subscriber to [Ryan Grim](https://substack.com/redirect/8ed64eeb-e7f8-4af7-b42b-80f1a4f9f224?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). ---
Hi Friend,
David Duke is not remembered fondly, which happens to former grand wizards of the Klan. But his campaign of demagoguery, racist dog whistles, and fear-mongering might sound familiar.
Edwin Edwards gave this warning just after defeating Duke in the race for Louisiana governor:
---
| | "I say to all of America tonight, there will be other places and other times where there will be other challenges by other David Dukes. They too will be peddling bigotry and division as their elixir of false hope, they too will be riding piggyback on the frustration of citizens disaffected by government.... "Tonight Louisiana defeated the darkness of hate, bigotry, and division, but where will the next challenge come from? Will it be in another campaign in Louisiana? Or in a campaign for governor in some other state? Or a campaign for president of the United States?"
---
| That was almost 33 years ago, but it's hard to miss the parallels with Donald Trump's campaign today. Trump has spent his political career "peddling bigotry and division."
Just a few of Trump's low-lights:
* calling for a "total and complete shutdown of Muslims entering the United States."
* referring to immigrants as "bad hombres" who are "bringing drugs. They're bringing crime. They're rapists."
* claiming that his felony indictments made him just like "the Black people."

These could all have been lines from David Duke. I don't imagine for a second that Donald Trump has a hooded white robe in his closet, but that doesn't make Trump any less dangerous.
Like any good demagogue, Trump consistently plays into fear and stokes prejudice rather than address the actual issues facing Americans today. So we need to defeat him the same way Edwin Edwards beat David Duke: challenging the fear-mongering while remaining focused on the American people's real concerns -- addressing, as Edwards put it, "the causes of public disenchantment with government."
One example strikes me as particularly apt. We need immigration reform as a country, but demonizing immigrants as "bad hombres" doesn't help us get there. In fact, we don't have immigration reform because Trump asked his buddies in Congress -- people like my opponent, John Carter -- to kill a bipartisan reform bill so Trump would have another talking point on the campaign trail. That's not leadership; it's political gamesmanship. It's Trump winning at the expense of the country losing.
Between now and November 5, we have to show voters the truth: that Trump, Carter, and their fellow MAGAites aren't focused on making Americans' lives better. They are focused on winning at any cost -- even at the expense of the American people -- and they will say and do anything to achieve that goal.
That's the message I'm spreading, and have been spreading since the start of my campaign. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu addresses a joint meeting of Congress on July 24, 2024 in Washington, DC. (Photo: X)
By Illinois Review

On Wednesday, U.S. Rep. Darin LaHood (R-IL) welcomed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to Washington and reiterated his support for Israel – one of America’s strongest allies, as the prime minister was in town to address a joint session of Congress as hundreds of pro-Palastenian protesters burned the American flag and destroyed public property just blocks from the U.S. Capitol where Netanyahu was delivering his speech.

Nearly 100 Democratic lawmakers boycotted the speech, including Vice President Kamala Harris – who chose to fill her schedule with other events instead, as scenes of rioters and protesters went viral on social media burning the American flag and spray painting words on public property that included, “F**k America,” “Hamas is Coming” and “Kill them all.” And inside the House chamber, U.S. Rep. Rashida Tlaib (D-Mich) – who just endorsed Harris for president, held up signs that read, “War Criminal” and “Guilty of Genocide” during Netanyahu’s speech.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/ir-exclusive-u-s-rep-darin-lahood-welcomes-israeli-pm-netanyahu-to-dc-calls-out-vile-antisemitic-anti-american-protesters-rioters.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c71e40e44d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/ir-exclusive-u-s-rep-darin-lahood-welcomes-israeli-pm-netanyahu-to-dc-calls-out-vile-antisemitic-anti-american-protesters-rioters.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c71e40e44d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
U.S. Rep. Darin LaHood (R-IL) and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. (Photo credit: Darin LaHood)
LaHood, who’s district covers central and northwestern parts of Illinois, and was in attendance for the prime minister’s address to a joint session of Congress on Wednesday, said in a statement shared exclusively with this publication,

“I was honored to welcome Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to Washington yesterday. As our strongest ally in the Middle East and the only democracy in the region, we must stand with Israel as they defend themselves from Hamas terrorists and work to return every hostage The decision by Vice President Kamala Harris not to preside over the Joint Session and the boycott of the address by numerous Democrat members of the Illinois delegation disrespects the institution of Congress, undermines America’s global leadership, appeases our adversaries, and weakens one of our strongest alliances.”

The congressman concluded with,

“I will continue to stand with Israel and work to return every hostage, and put an end to Hamas terrorism and other Iranian-backed proxies.”

Friend -- Understanding the historical method of analysis behind Diane Sare's July 1st warning of a possible threat to former President Donald Trump published in _The New Federalist_ newspaper is critical to thwarting any such future attempts. We include here a paragraph from that article: [Sare] said that Trump’s rejection of the British imperial agenda, as when he pulled the United States out of the Paris Climate Accord, and now his publicly stated view that it was NATO and the West which provoked Russia’s actions in Ukraine, stating truthfully that Ukraine “is not winning this war” and that he could “end the war in a day,” has provoked hysteria among the global elites who are depending on these policies of war and depopulation to keep their system together. In addition, Trump has repeatedly said that he questions the purpose and need for the NATO alliance, and has hinted that he would be willing to pull U.S. support from NATO. Most importantly, he has said that he sees no reason why he cannot sit down with both President Vladimir Putin of Russia and President Xi Jinping of China, "both who know me and respect me," to work out problems and "deals." That he might do that terrifies sections of the global elite. Unlike most political pundits of today, Diane, as well as other serious students of Lyndon LaRouche, understand the power of the United Sates presidency to change world history. Join us Friday evening as we delve into the history of the British Empire's attacks on this American institution which has played such an important role in shaping the modern world.

* * *
Today, at Mike Kehoe's campaign bus stops in Blue Springs and Kansas City, he was met with a fowl sight.

subject: Kamala Harris understands the art of a tuna sandwich
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Mark Warner
body:
and that’s just the tip of the iceberg when it comes to our Vice President

|
---

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89566393/487707166/1504340177?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Harris_240725_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZGE2NTFkZC1jNTRhLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9xcf5Ywj0UtFEhzOXZznoP28u-hBP7qXgfWXxYOON6g=) Derek,

You know how I feel about tuna sandwiches. I think they’re the perfect sandwich — and I’m not ashamed of how much mayo I use either.

Four years ago during the height of COVID lockdown, I joined Kamala Harris on a very important call: **The art of a tuna sandwich.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89566395/487707168/1504340177?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Harris_240725_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZGE2NTFkZC1jNTRhLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9xcf5Ywj0UtFEhzOXZznoP28u-hBP7qXgfWXxYOON6g=) Sure, she added some ingredients I never considered and used a skillet instead of a microwave, but the point is, she understands how to take something from its simplest form and rebuild it into something better. Frankly, that’s her superpower. And I believe that’s what will make her a great president.

Sometimes it feels like it’s impossible to find a path forward for our country amidst all the chaos — especially when Donald Trump is the Republican nominee for president again and he continues to spout lies and push for lawlessness on the campaign trail. I understand that under the circumstances, it’s hard to picture a brighter future.

I’ve had the honor of working alongside Vice President Kamala Harris for years. Her experience, energy, and resolve to fight for what everyday Americans deserve is unmatched. She’s dealt with chaos before and she always finds a path forward. I’m confident that she will do the same thing now and take down Donald Trump in November.

But she can’t do it alone. She needs us to join her and stand united against the forces that want to bring madness and mayhem back to the White House.

**[_So I’m asking: Will you split a donation today between me and Vice President Harris so we can come together for victory in November?_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89566397/487707170/1504340177?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Harris_240725_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZGE2NTFkZC1jNTRhLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9xcf5Ywj0UtFEhzOXZznoP28u-hBP7qXgfWXxYOON6g=)**

I’m all in for Kamala.

Thank you,

Mark Warner

P.S. Don’t forget to drain your tuna.

clean_body: and that’s just the tip of the iceberg when it comes to our Vice President | | | = Derek, You know how I feel about tuna sandwiches. I think they’re the perfect sandwich — and I’m not ashamed of how much mayo I use either. Four years ago during the height of COVID lockdown, I joined Kamala Harris on a very important call: The art of a tuna sandwich. = Sure, she added some ingredients I never considered and used a skillet instead of a microwave, but the point is, she understands how to take something from its simplest form and rebuild it into something better. Frankly, that’s her superpower. And I believe that’s what will make her a great president. Sometimes it feels like it’s impossible to find a path forward for our country amidst all the chaos — especially when Donald Trump is the Republican nominee for president again and he continues to spout lies and push for lawlessness on the campaign trail. I understand that under the circumstances, it’s hard to picture a brighter future. I’ve had the honor of working alongside Vice President Kamala Harris for years. Her experience, energy, and resolve to fight for what everyday Americans deserve is unmatched. She’s dealt with chaos before and she always finds a path forward. I’m confident that she will do the same thing now and take down Donald Trump in November. But she can’t do it alone. She needs us to join her and stand united against the forces that want to bring madness and mayhem back to the White House. = I’m all in for Kamala. Thank you, Mark Warner P.S. | | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future. For this reason, we have produced the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ --and I'm writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide. **What is the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_? ** The**_Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively. This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College--and we are making it available **free of charge**. To be clear, the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact. _We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ and our other outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative_. That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." With that mission in mind, we produced the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ --and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to _**support the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_ and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty**_**?** Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty--and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty--I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. **I 've included a secure link for your convenience here: ** _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-hillsdale-1776-curriculum](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=638d69d72a5143389a1f7a8638abf099&_e=Wdt62xBPOXCGAOWpDo_l0IrCUDy5l1QOc8wHwrQsgt4SNjwrKoAvNBttJbHWZT9tuRiJc7aSsUb4qQ8QxfNYtItz_88YPH4XlvrxtckZsRtgQn9CfNGIihrvMO7AA7j9FLqdRFEys8i0U_CQ9aFmtgU-cub1B0WNHp2GGS0R3Zt5KDN4tzGzrrlIuoM1cJZS9gM4lDGJJJ3aK9AuZ_kV2ki1XbpivLbqdA1xWRsJ0VNwy5Y-E-TWxe6XFDNYvPdxaAIwA9W49i6kBMbK_t1iMHE_YHHs61hkOoyN7tnbmPjLhbEtinc18plrRQ95BrjiVFHBBq-Ky_Zb3uke-NVDgtx_1gk7kBWOM9gV_LzagwWdMQygwUCtEk5nokpUkfOkulslDgGp95OkzRGUrXqGMtygIzqgu7BFFSXzsc3jdj0%3D)**_ Thank you for your time and attention. name: Andrew Yang
subject: Kamala Harris
body:
The Democrats have quickly coalesced around Kamala Harris as their presidential nominee. I will be voting for her and her running mate this Fall. | |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=fd4a506a01&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
---
|
---
| Hello, I hope that your summer is going great.

The Democrats have quickly coalesced around Kamala Harris as their presidential nominee. I will be voting for her and her running mate this Fall. I hope she wins.

Those of you who know me know that I believe Trump to be a disastrous candidate who will accelerate the disintegration of what’s left of American institutional trust. I know several people who worked for his first administration who resigned or were fired. They testify to Trump’s malignant nature as a leader. Many of them quietly scuttled Trump’s worst ideas so they never saw the light. His 2nd administration would be much worse – it would be staffed with sycophants and toadies who will actually try to follow through on Trump’s lesser impulses. I fear we would see abuses of power, political revenge and profiteering on a level we have never seen before with Trump back, buttressed by a Supreme Court ruling that makes every official act defensible.

If you’ve seen Trump lately, he seems increasingly old and deranged. That’s not the person you want in charge.

I have had the grim sense that Trump would return to power for months, even years now. Part of that was driven by my conviction that Joe Biden was a weak, unpopular, aging incumbent. I was incredibly frustrated that Biden and the Democrats were going to essentially serve the country back to Trump on a silver platter without much of a fight.

Joe Biden stepping aside has changed that. Thanks Joe!

Kamala Harris has given the Democrats a new lease on life. She and her campaign have raised over $100 million in the first several days from hundreds of thousands of donors. Volunteers are signing up in droves. Kamala seems energized and so do voters and surrogates who were in despair just last week. The sense of inevitability that has accompanied Donald Trump has now lifted.

Can Kamala Harris win in November?

Her campaign is off to a phenomenal start. I think she’ll win the popular vote. But the road ahead remains fraught. The Democrats’ path to victory runs through six states: Michigan, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Arizona, Nevada and Georgia. The Dems would like to include North Carolina on that list; the Republicans would like to include Virginia, Minnesota and New Hampshire. But it’s really just the core six swing states.
---
|
---
| Before Kamala Harris became the candidate, Arizona, Nevada and Georgia had all drifted toward Trump, leaving Dems with the narrow path of winning all of Michigan, Pennsylvania and Wisconsin. Trump is now spending $100 million in those three states to define Kamala negatively. Josh Shapiro, the governor of Pennsylvania, is a top choice to be Kamala’s running mate in part because he would help a lot in PA – he’s very popular there. I like that choice. Mark Kelly would have a similar, if lesser, impact in Arizona.

Normally, VP picks don’t matter all that much. But in this race everything could matter because it will likely be decided by a relative handful of voters in a few states.

On that front, Trump is likely regretting his pick of [JD Vance](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=e269bbb621&e=0f227c2ae3), who doesn’t bring a lot to the table electorally and may make things worse at the margins. Vance is the rare kind of politician who seems to court hostility, minus the celebrity status to make it okay.

Kamala needs to simultaneously turnout Democratic base voters and win over wavering swing voters in the Midwest and the sunbelt who don’t like Trump. She remains undefined in the minds of many voters. It’s a sprint. Her path is narrow. But there is a path, which is something I could not have said only days ago.

It’s the best chance we have to fend off Trump. I hope the country takes it.

If you want better choices, we do too! [Forward](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=f3f23dd500&e=0f227c2ae3) is backing good local candidates around the country and is growing all of the time. Check us out [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=985b47efe4&e=0f227c2ae3). And if you're in LA we are having a [picnic on August 4th](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=d7b18e9ca6&e=0f227c2ae3)!

clean_body: The Democrats have quickly coalesced around Kamala Harris as their presidential nominee. I will be voting for her and her running mate this Fall. | | | | | | | | | Hello, I hope that your summer is going great. The Democrats have quickly coalesced around Kamala Harris as their presidential nominee. I will be voting for her and her running mate this Fall. I hope she wins. Those of you who know me know that I believe Trump to be a disastrous candidate who will accelerate the disintegration of what’s left of American institutional trust. I know several people who worked for his first administration who resigned or were fired. They testify to Trump’s malignant nature as a leader. Many of them quietly scuttled Trump’s worst ideas so they never saw the light. His 2nd administration would be much worse – it would be staffed with sycophants and toadies who will actually try to follow through on Trump’s lesser impulses. I fear we would see abuses of power, political revenge and profiteering on a level we have never seen before with Trump back, buttressed by a Supreme Court ruling that makes every official act defensible. If you’ve seen Trump lately, he seems increasingly old and deranged. That’s not the person you want in charge. I have had the grim sense that Trump would return to power for months, even years now. Part of that was driven by my conviction that Joe Biden was a weak, unpopular, aging incumbent. I was incredibly frustrated that Biden and the Democrats were going to essentially serve the country back to Trump on a silver platter without much of a fight. Joe Biden stepping aside has changed that. Thanks Joe! Kamala Harris has given the Democrats a new lease on life. She and her campaign have raised over $100 million in the first several days from hundreds of thousands of donors. Volunteers are signing up in droves. Kamala seems energized and so do voters and surrogates who were in despair just last week. The sense of inevitability that has accompanied Donald Trump has now lifted. Can Kamala Harris win in November? Her campaign is off to a phenomenal start. I think she’ll win the popular vote. But the road ahead remains fraught. The Democrats’ path to victory runs through six states: Michigan, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Arizona, Nevada and Georgia. The Dems would like to include North Carolina on that list; the Republicans would like to include Virginia, Minnesota and New Hampshire. But it’s really just the core six swing states. | | Before Kamala Harris became the candidate, Arizona, Nevada and Georgia had all drifted toward Trump, leaving Dems with the narrow path of winning all of Michigan, Pennsylvania and Wisconsin. Trump is now spending $100 million in those three states to define Kamala negatively. Josh Shapiro, the governor of Pennsylvania, is a top choice to be Kamala’s running mate in part because he would help a lot in PA – he’s very popular there. I like that choice. Mark Kelly would have a similar, if lesser, impact in Arizona. Normally, VP picks don’t matter all that much. But in this race everything could matter because it will likely be decided by a relative handful of voters in a few states. On that front, Trump is likely regretting his pick of , who doesn’t bring a lot to the table electorally and may make things worse at the margins. Vance is the rare kind of politician who seems to court hostility, minus the celebrity status to make it okay. Kamala needs to simultaneously turnout Democratic base voters and win over wavering swing voters in the Midwest and the sunbelt who don’t like Trump. She remains undefined in the minds of many voters. It’s a sprint. Her path is narrow. But there is a path, which is something I could not have said only days ago. It’s the best chance we have to fend off Trump. I hope the country takes it. If you want better choices, we do too! is backing good local candidates around the country and is growing all of the time. body:
Gen Z is all in for Kamala Harris.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240725-1&t=1&akid=985%2E587540%2ENdT9P0)
I am so excited, Peter.
Like many Gen Z folks, I was a kid — just 8 years old — when President Obama launched his first presidential campaign. People who were involved with the campaign or witnessed it spoke so enthusiastically about the impact Obama had because he was able to tap into hope. **Something similar is happening now, Peter.**
Kamala Harris represents so much hope for our generation, especially in the face of what we are going up against this November. For the first time, Gen Z will be fighting _for_ something instead of standing up against something. That transition in mindset has already been so apparent.
**[If you are feeling as excited and hopeful as I am feeling right now, will you donate $5 right now to Kamala Harris’ campaign and send her a clear message that we are with her in this fight?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240725-1?refcode=em20240725-1&amount=5&refcode2=985_587540_NdT9P0&akid=985%2E587540%2ENdT9P0)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240725-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240725-1-985&refcode2=985_587540_NdT9P0&akid=985%2E587540%2ENdT9P0)**
The Harris Campaign has been very quick to embrace Gen Z! We see it in Kamala’s campaign adaption of the “brat” memes and in her ability to bring stars like Charli XCX and Olivia Rodrigo on board. _(Rest assured — I am still working on the Taylor Swift endorsement!)_
41 million members of Gen Z will be eligible to vote in 2024 and 63% of the new Gen Z voting base swings Democrat. I have heard from so many folks who were turned off from voting, who are now gearing up to cast their first presidential ballots this year!
In the two days since VP Harris’ campaign started, Vote.org saw a 700% spike in voting registrations with over 80% of these new registrations coming from folks under 34. **_Gen Z is a force to be reckoned with!_**
Kamala has already vowed to support policies that are beneficial to Gen Z like a ban on assault weapons. That only adds to her profile of being aligned with a majority of Gen Z when it comes to reproductive rights, climate change, LGBTQ+ rights, and more. We deserve leaders who are not afraid to reach out and speak to young voters — or who are young people themselves!
Leaders We Deserve is putting in the work day-to-day to uplift young leaders who are running in competitive races all across the United States – and we are already seeing unparalleled results. Our endorsed candidates have killed dangerous bills that would arm school teachers and advocated for reproductive rights as the most progressive voices in the most conservative spaces. Now, Gen Z is going to turn out for soon-to-be President Harris.
**[If you are with us in our mission to elect Kamala Harris and our group of endorsed young leaders in competitive races all across the county, will you chip in $5 to both Leaders We Deserve and the Harris campaign right now?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240725-1?refcode=em20240725-1&amount=5&refcode2=985_587540_NdT9P0&akid=985%2E587540%2ENdT9P0)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240725-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240725-1-985&refcode2=985_587540_NdT9P0&akid=985%2E587540%2ENdT9P0)**
With the backing of Gen Z, there is no reason why we won’t see Kamala Harris win come November — which also brings with it a mandate to enact policies that will set us up for success for YEARS to come! I’m so energized to see this hopeful and young energy from what has been a scary and stale election cycle so far.
LFG,
**David Hogg**
Leaders We Deserve
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-footer?refcode=em20240725-1&t=2&refcode2=985_587540_NdT9P0&akid=985%2E587540%2ENdT9P0)**

body:

#
_Content warning: this email discusses online harassment via digital forgeries of pornography._
We have an important update for you. Alexandria’s legislation, the _Defiance Act_ , just unanimously passed the Senate.
Over 90% of all deepfake videos made are nonconsensual sexually explicit images and 9 times out of 10, women are the target.
So, Alexandria worked closely with abuse survivors to introduce the _Disrupt Explicit Forged Images and Non-Consensual Edits (DEFIANCE) Act_ in the House of Representatives.
**Alexandria is committed to doing everything she can to pass the legislation through the House, send it to the President’s desk, and give survivors the ability to seek the justice they deserve.**
If the Defiance Act is passed, victims could sue anyone who ‘knew or recklessly disregarded’ their consent when they created, shared, or received the deepfake pornography.
[Alexandria came to Congress to legislate in a new way: by centering everyday people and the policies that benefit their lives. If you can, will you contribute $5 today so that she can stay in Congress to keep working for working people and not special interests?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240725.vyoidg&refcode=em20240725-6862-P_FND_RES_LEG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6862%2E2526796%2EVD73Jl)

Team AOC

body:
